1247.description: A friendly companion from the moldy habitat. Their silky wings are not fit for battle but they will support you from a safe distance.

1248.name: Fuzzy Egg
1248.description: A mysterious, mold-covered egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1249.name: Cracked Fuzzy Egg
1249.description: A mysterious, mold-covered egg that is about to hatch.

1250.name: Squishy Egg
1250.description: A mysterious, multi-layered egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1251.name: Cracked Squishy Egg
1251.description: A mysterious, mutli-layered egg that is about to hatch.

1252.name: Snugglygrade
1252.description: A cuddly, calm, and oddly brave companion. Watch it curl up and wiggle, but know that this new friend will not be afraid to join you in combat!

1253.name: Arcane Symbiote
1253.description: This strange creature feeds off arcane energies. While lacking physical influence, their ethereal power is felt by their host.

1254.name: Arcane Egg
1254.description: A luminescent egg pulsating with arcane energies. Is there a way to hatch it?

1255.name: Cracked Arcane Egg
1255.description: A luminescent egg that is about to hatch.

1256.name: Pest Egg
1256.description: A cybernetic egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1257.name: Cracked Pest Egg
1257.description: A mysterious, cybernetic egg that is about to hatch.

1258.name: Electro-Pet
1258.description: A tamed Electro-Pest. This spiky, otherworldly loaf of a predator is supplemented with electric coils. Their blue visor indicates friendliness to their owner.

1259.name: Nocturnal Egg
1259.description: A mysterious, leather-winged egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1260.name: Cracked Nocturnal Egg
1260.description: A mysterious, leather-winged egg that is about to hatch.

1261.name: Earie
1261.description: A big-eared companion that begs you to not confuse their ears with their wings! While too timid for aggression, their glowing eyes instill ensurance in allies and strike fear in foes.

1262.name: Hoppy Egg
1262.description: A mysterious, gelatinous egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1263.name: Cracked Hoppy Egg
1263.description: A mysterious, gelatinous egg that is about to hatch.

1264.name: Hoppet
1264.description: A friend from the sea that keeps the enemies at bay. Ribbit!

1265.name: Lazy Egg
1265.description: A mysterious, whiskered egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1266.name: Cracked Lazy Egg
1266.description: A mysterious, whiskered egg that is about to hatch.

1267.name: Cattiva
1267.description: A lazy companion with a temper. Avoids chores but compensates for it in battles.

1268.name: Glimmering Egg
1268.description: A mysterious, glimmering egg that seems to react to your presence. Is there a way to hatch it?

1269.name: Cracked Glimmering Egg
1269.description: A mysterious, glimmering egg that is about to hatch.

1270.name: Azeos Jr.
1270.description: A thunderous friend from the skies. Puts a spark into your battles.

1301.name: Feeding Tray
1301.description: This useful tray can be filled to the brim with cattle feed to keep cattle fed and happy.

1400.name: Owlboy - Main Title
1400.description: A composition containing an uplifting melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1401.name: Core Keeper - Base Theme
1401.description: A composition containing a homely melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1402.name: CSD!3!? – It's Dangerous To Go Alone
1402.description: A composition containing a motivating melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1403.name: Happy Birthday To You
1403.description: A composition containing a celebrative birthday melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1404.name: Terraria - Journey's Beginning
1404.description: A composition containing an adventurous melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1405.name: Stardew Valley - Spring (It's a Big World Outside)
1405.description: A composition containing a relaxing melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1406.name: Valheim - Meadows
1406.description: A composition containing a peaceful melody. Putting it on a music sheet stand lets one play the melody with an instrument.

1520.name: Gold Ore
1520.description: Rarely found in walls in the underground.

1521.name: Scarlet Ore
1521.description: Scarlet ore commonly found in grass walls.

1522.name: Octarine Ore
1522.description: Mysterious ore commonly found in limestone walls.

1523.name: Galaxite Ore
1523.description: Otherworldly ore commonly found in sandstone walls.

1524.name: Solarite Ore
1524.description: An ore that fused with Ancient Gemstones. It can sometimes be found in crystalline walls.

1525.name: Pandorium Ore
1525.description: An ore brimming with chaotic potential. Can be found growing on fossil ground.

1526.name: Relucite Ore
1526.description: An ore glowing of hardened amber mixed with amethyst. Commonly found in tuff walls.

1600.name: Ancient Gemstone
1600.description: Strange, blue gemstone emitting waves of energy.

1601.name: Jungle Emerald
1601.description: A verdant gemstone rarely found in crystalized lush regions. Its special properties allow it to be used for higher quality crafting.

1602.name: Ocean Sapphire
1602.description: An azure gemstone rarely found in crystalized aquatic regions. Its special properties allow it to be used for higher quality crafting.

1603.name: Desert Ruby
1603.description: A crimson gemstone rarely found in crystalized dry regions. Its special properties allow it to be used for higher quality crafting.

1610.name: Wood
1610.description: A piece of giant root to create all sorts of things.

1611.name: Thorn Wood
1611.description: A brambly variant of the common root wood.

1612.name: Coral Wood
1612.description: A red type of coral that is great for crafting.

1613.name: Gleam Wood
1613.description: A piece of glowing, crystallized wood that serves as an outstanding crafting material.

1630.name: Slime
1630.description: An orange blob of slime. Can be further processed.

1631.name: Poison Slime
1631.description: A purple blob of toxic slime. Can be further processed.

1632.name: Slippery Slime
1632.description: A blue slime blob almost too slick to hold onto. Can be further processed.

1633.name: Magma Slime
1633.description: A dark blob of flaming slime. Can be further processed.

1640.name: Fiber
1640.description: Silky-smooth material for creating fabric and armor.

1641.name: Wool
1641.description: An incredibly soft tuft of wool that has a pleasant scent to it.

1642.name: Strolly Poly Plate
1642.description: A cast-off plate that makes up the hard armor of a Strolly Poly. Very sturdy and great for crafting.

1645.name: Larva Meat
1645.description: Only true survivors eat it raw.

1646.name: Shiny Larva Meat
1646.description: Rare, golden variant of larva meat, with increased effects.

1648.name: Scrap Parts
1648.description: Different materials salvaged from junk. Used to repair items at the salvage and repair station.

1649.name: Cytoplasm
1649.description: Dark fluid from an oversized amoeba.

1650.name: Calcified Shell
1650.description: A composite material of calcite and fossilized seashells.

1651.name: Blasting Dung
1651.description: A volatile powder that ignites under pressure, releasing a sharp, unmistakable odor.

1652.name: Alien Fuse
1652.description: An alien electrical component that appears unstable.

1653.name: Corrupted Alloy
1653.description: An alloy of foreboding matter that feels hollow yet dense.

2021.name: Ancient Coin
2021.description: Valuable ancient coin, currency of the underground.

2500.name: Ghorm's Horn
2500.description: A pointy gemstone that let a larva grow way beyond its maximum size.

2501.name: Glurch Eye
2501.description: A bulbous gemstone that fused many slimes together into a giant one.

2502.name: Stolen Crystal Heart
2502.description: A giant ancient gemstone that mutated its holder into a monstrosity. It originally belonged to the Hive Mother, but was ripped out by a power-hungry caveling.

2503.name: Giant Slime Summoning Idol
2503.description: A small idol for one of the Underground's largest, stickiest mistakes. It feels heavier than it should.

2504.name: Ghorm Summoning Idol
2504.description: The Underground is full of tunnels that were never dug by hands. Hold this idol close, and you can almost feel the ground moving.

2505.name: Hive Mother Summoning Idol
2505.description: Warm to the touch, and faintly sticky.

2506.name: Malugaz Summoning Idol
2506.description: A reforged crystal skull from a cult that mistook obsession for devotion.

2508.name: Crown Summoning Idol
2508.description: A crown from another world, still sticky with royal slime. It has bounced through stranger kingdoms than this. Long may it squish.

2509.name: Haunted Hive Mother Summoning Idol
2509.description: The hive remembers every egg that never hatched, and every loss it suffered. Terrible news for anyone who decides to face it.

2510.name: Core Commander Summoning Idol
2510.description: A crystal interface with no maker's mark, built for a system older than The Underground remembers. The command inside is ancient and precise.

2511.name: Primeval Slime Cell
2511.description: A highly mutative, crystalized cell. Its black mucus attracts the oldest of organisms to where ancient lifeforms still roam.

2512.name: Corrupted Sap
2512.description: A hardened lump of corrupted sap, oozing void-like trails that cling and writhe.

2513.name: Hardened Sap
2513.description: This hardened hunk of sap lures bugs, small or gigantic, out of the ground! Just place it down and wait.

2514.name: Brood Void Neuron
2514.description: A glowing cell that phases through itself, twisted and pulled as if tethered to an unseen presence. Born of Nimruza's parasite, fused with Core-linked tissue, it carries a warped signal that may unseal what even the Core Network could not contain.

2515.name: Profane Override
2515.description: A keycard with intricately carved sigils between its circuits. Maybe it stores something beyond mere data?

3500.name: Yellow Glowbug
3500.description: This flying bug always appears in swarms which appear as dancing lights. Its yellow glow is biome-specific.

3501.name: Blue Glowbug
3501.description: This flying bug always appears in swarms which appear as dancing lights. Its blue glow is biome-specific.

3502.name: Green Glowbug
3502.description: This flying bug always appears in swarms which appear as dancing lights. Its green glow is biome-specific.

3503.name: Red Glowbug
3503.description: This flying bug always appears in swarms which appear as dancing lights. Its red glow is biome-specific.

3504.name: Purple Glowbug
3504.description: This flying bug always appears in swarms which appear as dancing lights. Its purple glow is biome-specific.

3510.name: Gem-Jellyfish
3510.description: A glowing kind of jellyfish that inherited ancient energy.

3680.name: Saddle
3680.description: Turns your cattle into a rideable mount until you take the saddle off.

3681.name: Racing Saddle
3681.description: Turns your cattle into a fast rideable mount until you take the saddle off.

3901.name: Ancient Hologram Pod
3901.description: A strange device that materializes spirits of the past.

3905.name: Little Helperling
3905.description: A fellow caveling that fits in your backpack but wants to be placed down soon because it's eager to work. It will craft presents in exchange for cooked food, give it rare cooked food for higher quality!

3930.name: Mysterious Idol
3930.description: A crystalline core statue. May attract someone looking for mysterious idols if placed in a habitable room.

3931.name: Slime Oil Idol
3931.description: A jar filled with slime essence, used for beard care. Place it in a habitable room and a bearded character may move in.

3932.name: Pile of Chum Idol
3932.description: Undigested remains of prey that could double down as food for fish. Place it in a habitable room and a character interested in fishing may move in.

3933.name: Cookies & Milk
3933.description: To trade with the one that decides who is naughty and who is nice.

3934.name: Seasonal Calendar
3934.description: A useful calendar that will attract a shady merchant when placed in a habitable room. Depending on the season, he will put on different costumes and offer new items.

3935.name: Nuclear Battery Idol
3935.description: A highly advanced piece of technology that stores nuclear energy. When placed in a habitable room, it will attract a bold traveler of the Shimmering Frontier.

3937.name: Void Idol
3937.description: A thorny statue of alien-looking make. Place it in a habitable room and an otherworldly visitor may move in.

4001.name: Ancient Fountain
4001.description: Only those with secret knowledge know where to find this fountain. It is powered by an ammonite fossil that crystalized through the presence of ancient gemstones.

4003.name: Basic Workbench
4003.description: The most basic of all workbenches.

4004.name: Furnace
4004.description: This standard furnace melts basic metal ores.

4005.name: Electronics Table
4005.description: Workbench to create electrical and logical systems.

4008.name: Alchemy Table
4008.description: Workbench to tinker with the wonders of chemistry.

4009.name: Table Saw
4009.description: A simple saw to cut materials into slates. Requires electricity.

4010.name: Iron Workbench
4010.description: Essential workbench for survival in the underground.

4011.name: Copper Anvil
4011.description: Get started with creating armor for looks and combat.

4012.name: Jewelry Workbench
4012.description: Workbench for creating rings and necklaces.

4013.name: Cooking Pot
4013.description: Cooking ingredients brings out their full potential. Combine two and see what happens!

4014.name: Iron Anvil
4014.description: Great for creating high tier equipment.

4015.name: Smelter Kiln
4015.description: A kiln that can melt valuable ores.

4016.name: Scarlet Workbench
4016.description: Greater workbench to be prepared for the outer cave systems.

4017.name: Railway Forge
4017.description: Advanced forge to create underground rail systems.

4018.name: Painter's Table
4018.description: Workbench to create a selection of colorful brushes.

4019.name: Tin Workbench
4019.description: A better workbench to prepare you for the underground world.

4020.name: Tin Anvil
4020.description: A better anvil for creating gear and weapons more suited for survival.

4021.name: Scarlet Anvil
4021.description: A very advanced anvil for creating supreme equipment.

4023.name: Cartography Table
4023.description: A table to share your map discoveries with other explorers.

4024.name: Octarine Anvil
4024.description: A strange anvil for creating extraordinary equipment.

4025.name: Salvage and Repair Station
4025.description: Scraps tools, equipment and other things you don't need, or refurbishes broken ones.

4026.name: Distillery Table
4026.description: This table is used for refining ground slime into a slime material.

4027.name: Octarine Workbench
4027.description: Mystical workbench for creating extraordinary gear.

4028.name: Fishing Workbench
4028.description: A useful workbench to create fishing nets and all kinds of fishing lures with beneficial effects.

4029.name: Dresser
4029.description: Allows changing the equipment shown on your character.

4030.name: Proficient Jewelry Workbench
4030.description: An advanced workbench for creating rings and necklaces.

4031.name: Boat Workbench
4031.description: This wide workstation allows the construction of different boats. Ahoy!

4032.name: Fury Forge
4032.description: An unstable forge producing incredible heat able to smelt the hardest of metals.

4033.name: Galaxite Workbench
4033.description: Otherworldly workbench that helps tremendously to survive in the deepest caves.

4034.name: Galaxite Anvil
4034.description: A special anvil for creating otherworldly equipment.

4035.name: Key Casting Table
4035.description: A workbench with changeable casting plates to create all kinds of different keys.

4036.name: Go-Kart Workbench
4036.description: A long crafting table to engineer fast vehicles for your travels.

4037.name: Festive Workbench
4037.description: This crafting table is perfect to create holiday decorations for the cold season.

4038.name: Magic Mirror
4038.description: This mysterious piece of furniture has been enhanced in strange ways. Looking into it makes it possible to change your appearance.

4039.name: Mannequin
4039.description: A wooden figure that's great for showcasing gear and feeling less alone.

4040.name: Valentine Crafting Table
4040.description: A workbench containing tools and blueprints to create some beautiful decorative items.

4041.name: Loom
4041.description: This archaic device makes it possible to turn fiber into beautiful clothing and costumes.

4042.name: Music Workbench
4042.description: This writers' table sparks the inspiration for tools and compositions used to conduct music.

4043.name: Copper Workbench
4043.description: A versatile workbench to prepare you for the underground world.

4044.name: Glass Smelter
4044.description: This handy furnace can turn any sand block into useful glass.

4045.name: Glass Workbench
4045.description: This workbench makes it possible to form glass into more advanced objects to add to your base.

4046.name: Upgrade Station
4046.description: A high-tech workbench to upgrade tools and weapons, making them stronger and more effective.

4047.name: Solarite Anvil
4047.description: A superior anvil for creating magnificent equipment.

4048.name: Livestock Workbench
4048.description: A workbench to create helpful tools and furniture for keeping happy animals.

4049.name: Solarite Workbench
4049.description: A superior workbench to be prepared for dire trials.

4050.name: Samhain Workbench
4050.description: A coffin-shaped workbench that aids the creation of eerie furniture.

4051.name: Hydra Altar
4051.description: A ritual workbench that allows the crafting of instruments that can only be heard by the beasts of the deep.

4052.name: Pouch Workbench
4052.description: A workbench where pouches can be fabricated, for a more organized inventory.

4053.name: Laboratory Table
4053.description: A workbench that can be used to concoct complex potions and explosives.

4054.name: Fishing Net
4054.description: Lures in fish using critters as bait.

4055.name: Advanced Automation Table
4055.description: An advanced workbench for creating complex machines.

4056.name: Relucite Smithing Table
4056.description: An alien workstation for ingenious gear creation.

4057.name: Large Industrial Table
4057.description: A large table with brass rims and a board made from a sleek alloy.

4058.name: Industrial Table
4058.description: A table with brass rims and a board made from a sleek alloy.

4059.name: Critter Catcher
4059.description: Once crops are placed inside, it'll be irresistible to critters of the local biome.

4060.name: Metalcrafter's Table
4060.description: A reinforced workbench for robust architecture.

4061.name: Training Dummy
4061.description: A patient sparring partner. Never fights back.

4097.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Console
4097.description: In its reflective monitor, it feels like more than your reflection looks back.

4099.name: Portal
4099.description: Allows teleporting to waypoints and portals that have been placed out. The portal takes 10 minutes to charge up before it can be used once it has been placed.

4100.name: Electricity Generator
4100.description: Powers wires and objects with electricity.

4151.name: Arrow Sign
4151.description: Don't know where to go? Just look at it!

4152.name: Skull Effigy
4152.description: There is no clearer warning than a skull on a stake. Better keep out.

4153.name: Brute Sign
4153.description:
Someone put all their artistic efforts into painting this sign and left it as a warning.
Caveling Brutes or worse ahead.

4154.name: Sign
4154.description: The best way to leave messages for everyone to see.

4155.name: Metropolis Sign
4155.description: A modern message sign that can be programmed to display information.

4156.name: Yellow Warning Sign
4156.description: A plaque on a pole with a heed of caution judging by its shape.

4157.name: Red Warning Sign
4157.description: A plaque on a pole with a heed of extreme caution judging by the vibrant red color.

4700.name: Wood Floor
4700.description: Simple wooden slats for decorating your base.

4701.name: Wood Fence Gate
4701.description: A simple gate for the wooden fence.

4702.name: Wood Fence
4702.description: A simple fence to protect what's rightfully yours.

4703.name: Wood Bridge
4703.description: Used to cross chasms and water but also makes for a nice floor.

4704.name: Stone Floor
4704.description: Simple rock tiles for decorating your base.

4705.name: Stone Fence Gate
4705.description: A simple gate for the stone fence.

4706.name: Stone Fence
4706.description: A more reinforced fence to protect what's rightfully yours.

4707.name: Stone Bridge
4707.description: Used to cross chasms and water but also makes for a nice floor.

4708.name: Paintable Floor
4708.description: A paintable bleak stone floor to make your base more colorful.

4709.name: Scarlet Floor
4709.description: A reinforced metal floor tile with a nice crimson alloy.

4710.name: Scarlet Fence Gate
4710.description: A tough metal gate for the scarlet fence.

4711.name: Scarlet Fence
4711.description: A reinforced metal fence to protect what's rightfully yours.

4712.name: Scarlet Bridge
4712.description: Used to cross chasms and water but also makes for a nice floor.

4713.name: Lit Floor
4713.description: A plain floor tile that magically lights up by itself. Can be painted and placed under almost every other floor cover.

4714.name: Coral Floor
4714.description: A floor made from little organic tiles and differently colored sea floor pebbles.

4715.name: Coral Fence Gate
4715.description: A fitting gate for the coral fence.

4716.name: Coral Fence
4716.description: A neat little fence made from pink corals.

4717.name: Coral Bridge
4717.description: A shimmering bridge supported by coral pillars that are reaching down into the sea ground.

4718.name: Galaxite Floor
4718.description: An otherworldly floor that feels like walking on the night sky.

4719.name: Galaxite Fence Gate
4719.description: An otherworldly, elegant gate for the galaxite fence.

4720.name: Galaxite Fence
4720.description: An otherworldly, elegant fence for keeping your base safe.

4721.name: Galaxite Bridge
4721.description: An otherworldly bridge that feels like walking on a path through the universe.

4722.name: Glass Floor
4722.description: A see-through tile to provide a crystal-clear vision of the ground underneath.

4723.name: Thin Glass Wall
4723.description: A thin wall made from glass, perfect to create enclosures.

4724.name: Glass Bridge
4724.description: A transparent bridge that has no supports and that can be built across water or chasms.

4725.name: Woven Straw Floor
4725.description: A reinforced floor, woven from meadow straw.

4726.name: Gleam Wood Floor
4726.description: An enigmatic floor decorated with patterned tiles.

4727.name: Gleam Wood Fence Gate
4727.description: A pale, elegant gate for the gleam wood fence.

4728.name: Gleam Wood Fence
4728.description: A pale, elegant fence for keeping your base safe.

4729.name: Gleam Wood Bridge
4729.description: An enigmatic bridge that floats in space and that can be built across water or chasms.

4750.name: Rug
4750.description: Cover up the cold ground and make your base cozy.

4751.name: Woven Mat
4751.description: Groundcover made from a net of firm plants.

4752.name: Loose Flooring
4752.description: A collection of workable groundcover made from clay. A true hobbyist might turn them into different shapes and colors.

4753.name: Rose Petal Flooring
4753.description: This little paper bag contains enough rose petals to cover a 1x1 floor tile with them. Great to lay out a path of love.

4760.name: Bed
4760.description: A place to sleep. Also allows friendly inhabitants to move in if placed in a room to their liking.

4770.name: Wood Door
4770.description: Close up your base with this simple door.

4771.name: Stone Door
4771.description: A sturdier door to block out unwanted creatures.

4772.name: Scarlet Door
4772.description: A reinforced door to shut out anyone uninvited.

4773.name: Metal Grate
4773.description: A metal bridge that was used to cross lava in the molten quarry.

4774.name: Gleam Wood Door
4774.description: An unyielding door to keep adversaries at bay.

4775.name: Coral Door
4775.description: A neat door made of colorful organic materials.

4776.name: Galaxite Door
4776.description: An otherworldly and nearly indestructible door.

4777.name: Tapestry
4777.description: A sheet of fabric that can be hung on walls.

4778.name: Banner
4778.description: A tall, wooden frame with a sheet of fabric hanging down from the top.

4779.name: Lamp Post
4779.description: A tall bright lit pillar clad in brass, fitting for illuminating dark liminal paths.

4800.name: Siren Lamp
4800.description: A durable lamp designed for simple alert systems underground.

4801.name: Wall Light Bulb
4801.description: The sophisticated alternative to decorative torches.

4802.name: Industrial Bridge
4802.description: Its supporting beams seem intended to withstand cargo of immeasurable weight.

4803.name: Obsidian Door
4803.description: A door made of perplexingly hardened obsidian.

4804.name: Obsidian Key
4804.description: A sharp key cast in obsidian. There should be a lock somewhere that it fits into.

4805.name: Locked Obsidian Door
4805.description: A door made of perplexingly hardened obsidian. It could be opened with the right key.

5010.name: Caveling Skull
5010.description: Remains of what was once a proud civilization.

5011.name: Leaf Fossil
5011.description: Proof of a once flourishing environment.

5012.name: Ammonite
5012.description: The petrified shell of an ancient sea creature.

5013.name: Geode
5013.description: Half of a rock with beautiful crystals inside.

5016.name: Old Amulet
5016.description: Brittle stone jewelry. Too small to be worn by a human.

5017.name: Ear Plate
5017.description: A squarish earring plated with gold.

5018.name: Bone Creole
5018.description: A crude piece of jewelry carved from bone.

5019.name: Triangle Trinket
5019.description: A strange gold piece vibrating with energy.

5020.name: Twisted Agate
5020.description: A green gem shaped like a spiral.

5021.name: Blood Skull
5021.description: The crimson remains of someone meeting a terrible fate.

5022.name: Grub Knot
5022.description: A mutated lump of small grubs. Disgusting.

5023.name: Petrified Egg
5023.description: Fossilized egg shell, it feels light and brittle.

5024.name: Old Spore Mask
5024.description: An old mask protecting against air-borne spores. It's broken but may still fetch a good price.

5025.name: Hard Thorn
5025.description: A sturdy wooden thorn that can quickly poke careless fingers.

5026.name: Balloon Spore
5026.description: A fluffy giant spore. It's non-toxic but also not very useful.

5027.name: Caveling Doll
5027.description: A handmade doll found in a grave. It must once have belonged to a child...

5028.name: Small Caveling Skull
5028.description: A caveling skull, smaller than usual. It hints at a tragic story.

5029.name: Golden Feather
5029.description: It's big and shiny, a must have for collectors.

5030.name: Mechanical Arm
5030.description: An overgrown piece of ancient technology. The joints are stiff but it must have performed remarkable tasks in the past.

5031.name: Dry Butterfly
5031.description: A dead insect void of any moisture. It is nice to look at but needs to be handled with care.

5032.name: Precious Urn
5032.description: A pretty decorative without any cracks and blemishes but its original contents are long gone.

5033.name: Amber Chunk
5033.description: Solid remains of an ancient forest. The light it reflects is warm and golden.

5034.name: Petrified Coral
5034.description: A gray and porous piece of a giant ecosystem. The ocean it belonged to seems long gone.

5035.name: Mold Dew
5035.description: Golden-colored dew that emanated from mold spores, maybe someone can find a use for it.

5036.name: Fungal Bone
5036.description: Rotten with mold down to the marrow, its owner must have suffered greatly.

5037.name: Mildew Leaf
5037.description: A leaf with white mold spots on it, apart from that it looks unscathed.

5038.name: Chipped Plate
5038.description: An old stone plate. What kind of food has been served on it?

5039.name: Stone Cap
5039.description: Rock-hard mushrooms attached to a stone slate. They look edible but are actually fossilized.

5040.name: Giant Mite
5040.description: A motionless crimson critter. It just sits there...watching...

5041.name: Rusty Spoon
5041.description: An old, corroded eating utensil. Almost every culture has invented it.

5042.name: Green Kelp
5042.description: A green lump of marine plants.

5043.name: Golden Starfish
5043.description: A razorsharp ocean critter polished clean by currents.

5044.name: Amber Fish Egg
5044.description: A perfectly preserved fish egg encapsulated in amber. How those two combined is a mystery.

5045.name: Soft Sponge
5045.description: A soft, squishy sponge. Time to take a bath!

5046.name: Adder Stone
5046.description: A porous smooth stone, some believe it wards off evil spirits.

5047.name: Caveling Perfume
5047.description: A blue fragrance bottle. It is tightly sealed but emits a heavenly scent.

5048.name: Enhydro Crystal
5048.description: Ancient water is encapsulated in this beautiful crystal. It's been in there for millions of years.

5049.name: Mucus Amoeba
5049.description: A slimy giant amoeba, it seems to be looking at you.

5050.name: Parasite Fossil
5050.description: The petrified remains of an ancient parasite, it is uncertain if it's really dead.

5051.name: Golden Cocoon
5051.description: A gold-plated chrysalis, this doesn't seem to be its final form.

5052.name: Grub Pearl
5052.description: Is it a grub-shaped pearl or a pearl-like grub?

5053.name: Giant Germ
5053.description: A big bacterium wiggling around in your hand, fascinating and gross at the same time.

5054.name: Mold Shell
5054.description: The fuzzy, pale housing of a critter that has moved on.

5055.name: Ceremonial Flute
5055.description: An ancient, precious instrument but it is clogged.

5056.name: Data Slate
5056.description: A stone disc with peculiar engravings, it must contain mysterious records.

5057.name: Lost Paddle
5057.description: Somewhere, someone must have paddled in circles.

5058.name: Feather Fish Scale
5058.description: Scale of the Feather Fish, it is sturdy but as light as a feather.

5059.name: Caveling Medal
5059.description: A minted medallion with a face relief. Perhaps it was once awarded to an extraordinary individual?

5060.name: Rainbow Kelp
5060.description: A super rare mutation of common kelp, showing off a variety of colors.

5061.name: Bubble Pearl
5061.description: A beautiful, iridescent pearl. It seems to be hollow.

5062.name: Black Bubble Pearl
5062.description: A black variant of the bubble pearl, from certain angles it appears golden.

5063.name: Sealed Beverage
5063.description: An unknown liquid slushes inside when shaken. Is there an ancient corkscrew around?

5064.name: Shark Tooth
5064.description: It's as big as the palm of a hand, meeting with a row of those will end up fatal.

5065.name: Forked Coral
5065.description: A trident-shaped coral, not very valuable but nice to look at.

5066.name: Petrified Trilobite
5066.description: The fossil of a long gone critter species. They are ancestors of a big variety of lifeforms.

5067.name: Rusty Fishing Hook
5067.description: Rusted to the core and unusable. That fish was too big to handle, pal.

5068.name: Fish Fossil
5068.description: The imprint of an ancient fish on a rock slate.

5069.name: Fizzy Crystal
5069.description: A bubbly stone that is as clear as water. It weighs almost nothing.

5070.name: Gray Kelp
5070.description: A gray lump of marine plants.

5071.name: Yellow Kelp
5071.description: A yellow lump of marine plants.

5072.name: Pale Kelp
5072.description: A pale lump of marine plants.

5073.name: Red Kelp
5073.description: A red lump of marine plants.

5074.name: Early Human Skull
5074.description: Remains of a human that lived about 200.000 years ago. Has mankind found these caves before?

5075.name: Golden Caveling Mask
5075.description: An intricate mask with a stern expression, it was probably used in a ritual or by someone of high ranks.

5076.name: Ancient Gem Plate
5076.description: This shimmering plate has intricate engravings, it looks like a key to something.

5077.name: Antique Board Game
5077.description: An ancient game for two players, there is no rulebook but apparently it was about shifting blocks around.

5078.name: Music Bowl
5078.description: A precious bowl holding a golden cylinder that once seemed to have played a melancholic melody. But it stopped working.

5079.name: Seismic Clock
5079.description: This broken device looks like it was able to predict earthquakes.

5080.name: Old Journal
5080.description: A leather-bound book with crumbly pages. It is written in familiar letters but a language you don't know.

5081.name: Mysterious Doll Set
5081.description: A pair of green dolls wearing clothes, sitting together they look like great pals.

5082.name: Ritual Goblet
5082.description: An ancient chalice made from stone and gems. Its insides are layered with dark red residue.

5083.name: Oracle Card "Entity"
5083.description: A bent card with golden borders and an image of the core. Looks like it's part of a set.

5084.name: Glurch Figurine
5084.description: A lifelike representation of Glurch the Abominous Mass. The gemstone at its center might hint at how that monstrosity came to life.

5085.name: Ivy Figurine
5085.description: A tiny sculpture of Ivy the Poisonous Mass, the plant-like monstrosity which chokes the forest with toxic tendrils.

5086.name: Ghorm Figurine
5086.description: A tiny miniature of Ghorm the Devourer, which captures the hunger of a creature said to consume anything in its path.

5087.name: Hive Mother Figurine
5087.description: An eerie sculpture of the Hive Mother, depicting a creepy, bloated mom suited to its surroundings.

5088.name: Slime Figurine
5088.description: A tiny model of the most common of blobs, an Orange Slime.

5089.name: Purple Slime Figurine
5089.description: A miniature representation of a Purple Slime. A cute blob in a purple shade, who would have thought it could be that poisonous?

5090.name: Red Slime Figurine
5090.description: A lifelike representation of a Red Slime. Even these spikes are aggressive to the touch.

5091.name: Acid Larva Figurine
5091.description: A lifelike representation of an Acid Larva. It captures the twitchy menace of a creature known to chase its prey before exploding.

5092.name: Larva Figurine
5092.description: A small likeness of a Larva, representing the tiny creatures that won't let you go until you stop moving.

5093.name: Big Larva Figurine
5093.description: A tiny likeness of a Big Larva. It captures a creature known to snuff out any torch in its wake. Perhaps it can be befriended?

5094.name: Hive Larva Figurine
5094.description: A creepy miniature of a Hive Larva. A much redder version of the common Larva.

5095.name: Big Hive Larva Figurine
5095.description: A creepy miniature of a Big Hive Larva. A much redder version of the more common Big Larva.

5096.name: Caveling Figurine
5096.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling. A simple cave-dweller with a face that suggests you are not welcome.

5097.name: Caveling Gardener Figurine
5097.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Gardener. Using a hoe as a weapon, this variety of Caveling is also able to bring life to a strange species of plant.

5098.name: Caveling Hunter Figurine
5098.description: A figurine of a Caveling Hunter that depicts a stealthy predator that hides among the foliage and strikes the careless.

5099.name: Caveling Shaman Figurine
5099.description: A miniature representation of a Caveling Shaman. It depicts one of the rare few among its kind able to wield magic, although unable to do it bare-handed.

5100.name: Infected Caveling Figurine
5100.description: A miniature that captures an Infected Caveling perfectly. Twisted by mold infection, these Cavelings don't seem to be able to do much thinking.

5101.name: Caveling Brute Figurine
5101.description: A miniature of a Caveling Brute. It captures the brutish form of a creature built on strength rather than brains.

5102.name: Azeos Figurine
5102.description: A carefully sculpted likeness of Azeos the Sky Titan. Its wings seem very detailed for a miniature.

5103.name: Malugaz Figurine
5103.description: A miniature of Malugaz the Corrupted, a dangerous mixture of intelligence and strength. It's a shame it seems to not have been used for good.

5104.name: Tentacle Figurine
5104.description: A tiny model of a Tentacle which seems to hold onto its pearl more than its real counterpart.

5105.name: Mold Tentacle Figurine
5105.description: A lifelike representation of a Mold Tentacle. It's good to think that at least this one will not try to aim at your head.

5106.name: Snare Plant Figurine
5106.description: A lifelike representation of a Snare Plant. You've heard of carnivorous plants, but it's news to find one that simply snares its prey.

5107.name: Blue Slime Figurine
5107.description: A miniature blob representing a Blue Slime. Much less slippery than its in-person version.

5108.name: Oracle Card "Aura"
5108.description: A ripped card with golden borders and an image of an ancient gemstone. Looks like it's part of a set.

5109.name: Oracle Card "Brilliance"
5109.description: A charred card with golden borders and an image of a Glow Tulip. Looks like it's part of a set.

5110.name: Awakened Azeos Figurine
5110.description: A lifelike representation of the Awakened Azeos. A beautifully unique form of the familiar sky titan.

5111.name: Screen Device
5111.description: A small device made from blue glass, perfectly fitting into your hand. It's touch sensitive and scrolls through images and glyphs.

5112.name: Caveling Effigy
5112.description: A small depiction of a caveling, it's hollow and must have been used for storing small goods.

5113.name: Crystal Sphere
5113.description: A small orb made from deep-blue glass. Its purpose is unknown.

5114.name: Luxurious Handmirror
5114.description: A hand-held mirror in great condition. Clearly someone had a sense of beauty.

5115.name: Processor Chip
5115.description: This intricate, golden chip seems technically very advanced and must have computed complex calculations.

5116.name: Timeless Hourglass
5116.description: An intact hourglass, filled with blue sand. It is not clear what period of time it measures, as the sand seems to fall incredibly slowly.

5117.name: Playing Dice
5117.description: A playing dice with unique symbols on each face. It's probably been used in sets and for multiple different games.

5118.name: Golden Whistle
5118.description: A small golden whistle with unknown purpose. The sounds it emits is almost unnoticable.

5119.name: Bent Fork
5119.description: A simple fork that has seen too much use.

5120.name: Caveling Cup
5120.description: This small drinking cup must have held many different beverages. There is still a faint smell of something sweet.

5121.name: Oracle Card "Wisdom"
5121.description: A soaked card with golden borders and an image of a caveling scholar. Looks like it's part of a set.

5122.name: Oracle Card "Metropolis"
5122.description: A card in mint condition with golden borders and an image of an ancient city. Looks like it's part of a set.

5123.name: Oracle Card "Inspiration"
5123.description: Half of a card with golden borders and an image of a golden mask. Looks like it's part of a set.

5124.name: Core Figurine
5124.description: A finely crafted representation of the Core. It carries a strangely familiar presence.

5125.name: Morpha Figurine
5125.description: A tiny model of Morpha, the Aquatic Mass, the lesser horror in The Sunken Sea.

5126.name: Cocoon Figurine
5126.description: A miniature of a Cocoon. The real one is a jiggly capsule that brings multiple larvae to life at once.

5127.name: Omoroth Figurine
5127.description: A lifelike representation of Omoroth, the Sea Titan. It's weird to not see its tentacles here.

5128.name: Bubble Crab Figurine
5128.description: This miniature of a Bubble Crab is irritating enough even without the bubbles.

5129.name: Core Sentry Figurine
5129.description: A finely crafted representation of a Core Sentry. Never before has the miniature of a statue looked so majestic.

5130.name: Caveling Scholar Figurine
5130.description: A small figurine depicting a Caveling Scholar. It seems to be clutching its secrets beneath a very serious hood.

5131.name: Giant Squid Eye
5131.description: A sensory organ of a big sea creature. It probably was lost in a fight to death with something even bigger.

5132.name: Golden Needle
5132.description: This little treasure was used to hold the robe of a caveling scholar in place.

5133.name: Polished Shell
5133.description: A mirror-like smooth shell that was ground down by currents and swirling sand from the sea ground.

5134.name: Opabinia Fossil
5134.description: The petrified body of an prehistoric sea critter. They were one of the first apex predators to appear in the ancient oceans of earth.

5135.name: Blue Kelp
5135.description: A blue lump of marine plants.

5136.name: Shrooman Figurine
5136.description: A lifelike representation of a Shrooman. The cutest cap perfectly matching the creature that makes the cutest sounds.

5137.name: King Slime Figurine
5137.description: A lifelike representation of the King Slime. There are whispers of it being a failed experiment, with its crown being a mockery of lost royalty.

5138.name: Oracle Card "Radiance"
5138.description: A scratched card with golden borders and an image of the sky titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

5139.name: Oracle Card "Temperance"
5139.description: A faded card with golden borders and an image of the sea titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

5140.name: Oracle Card "Endurance"
5140.description: A crumbling card with golden borders and an image of the sand titan. Looks like it's part of a set.

5141.name: Blue Glass Shard
5141.description: A piece of deep blue glass, it appears to be a fusion of molten sand and ancient gemstones.

5142.name: Charred Caveling Skull
5142.description: A small skull burnt dark to the marrow. Exposure to intense heat for a long time causes something like this to happen.

5143.name: Caveling Sandal
5143.description: This simple footwear is perfect as a protection against hot desert sand. Unfortunately it's too small to be worn by a human.

5144.name: Worker Handcuff
5144.description: Cast from thick metal this tool seemed to be attached to a chain. Has it been used to keep the unlawful from running away?

5145.name: Crystal Spearhead
5145.description: The leftovers of a crude prehistoric weapon made with an ancient gemstone. It may have helped early humans to hunt more effectively.

5146.name: Melting Lava Wing
5146.description: The wing of a lava butterfly, swinging it causes sparks to fly off in all directions.

5147.name: Plume Ball
5147.description: A bundle of leaves that grows on plume trees.

5148.name: Pickaxe Head
5148.description: The top part of an iron pickaxe that is partially molten. It must have been broken while working under extreme conditions.

5149.name: Desert Diamond
5149.description: A very rare crystal sparkling with a beautiful white light.

5150.name: Black Desert Diamond
5150.description: The black variant of a desert diamond that is highly sought after by miners. It seems to invert reflected light and cast it back as shadows.

5151.name: Bag of Marbles
5151.description: A small bag holding multiple colored marbles made from glass and cheap gemstones. They have probably been used for child's games.

5152.name: Ancient Golden Coin
5152.description: This coin cast in gold seems to be a much older currency than the common ancient coins. It's also worth a whole lot more.

5153.name: Incense Bowl
5153.description: A porcelain bowl with blue details on the edge and dark residue in its center. The smell that still lingers around it eases the senses.

5154.name: Ancient Makeup Set
5154.description: A small wooden box containing all kinds of brushes, pastes and powders that have been used for makeup.

5155.name: Caveling Prophet Mask
5155.description: This intricate mask seems to have been worn by an important spiritual figure.

5156.name: Frozen Flame
5156.description: A gemstone that is shaped like crystalline fire.

5160.name: Igneous Figurine
5160.description: Igneous, the Molten Mass, in the shape of a tiny figurine representing the fiery slime blob.

5161.name: Ra-Akar Figurine
5161.description: A miniature of Ra-Akar, the Sand Titan. Thankfully, those triangles won't be spawned by this one.

5162.name: Bomb Scarab Figurine
5162.description: A lifelike representation of a Bomb Scarab. Its wings are reminiscent of a skull.

5163.name: Lava Butterfly Figurine
5163.description: A lifelike representation of a Lava Butterfly. Who knew lava could fly?

5164.name: Caveling Assassin Figurine
5164.description: A lifelike miniature of a Caveling Assassin. It captures the menace of a creature known for its thrown daggers.

5165.name: Lava Slime Figurine
5165.description: A lifelike representation of a Lava Slime.

5166.name: Broken Gourd
5166.description: A broken container made from clay. It was used to carry rations of water across the desert.

5167.name: Kingfish Scale
5167.description: This beautiful scale seems to belong to a truly extraordinary fish.

5168.name: Broken Toy Ship
5168.description: A leaking wooden ship that is missing its sail.

5169.name: Flesh Kelp
5169.description: A flesh-colored lump of marine plants.

5170.name: Ancient Fishing Hook
5170.description: A very old design for a fishing hook that is not used anymore.

5171.name: Fusion Alloy
5171.description: Looks like a failed experiment to create a new type of alloy. It is too hard to be usable in any way.

5172.name: Starlight Shards
5172.description: A collection of sparkling colorful crystals. If they grew natural or not remains a mystery.

5173.name: Dark Blue Kelp
5173.description: A dark blue lump of marine plants.

5174.name: White Whistle
5174.description: A rare artifact made from precious, white stone. It doesn't produce a sound when you try to use it.

5175.name: Haunted Hive Mother Figurine
5175.description: A lifelike representation of the Haunted Hive Mother. And you thought the Hive Mother couldn't be creepier.

5176.name: Frankenbrute Figurine
5176.description: A spooky representation of a Frankenbrute. It's not alive!

5177.name: Pumpking Caveling Figurine
5177.description: A terrifying Pumpking Caveling's figurine. Not much can be as scary as a Caveling with a glowing pumpkin for a head.

5178.name: Spookaveling Figurine
5178.description: A seasonal representation of a Spookaveling. Spooky indeed.

5179.name: Big Dracularva Figurine
5179.description: A spooky model of a Big Dracularva. Who would have thought a cape could look so flattering!

5180.name: Caveling Skirmisher Figurine
5180.description: A lifelike representation of a Caveling Skirmisher. It depicts a creature which seems to know how to handle a spear well... by aiming it at your head.

5181.name: Caveling Spearman Figurine
5181.description: This miniature of a Caveling Spearman captures the threatening posture of a hostile spear wielder.

5182.name: Crystal Star
5182.description: A golden-colored glass star for decorating the base in a festive fashion. Better not drop it.

5183.name: Snow Globe
5183.description: This little globe has the core as its center and starts a snowfall when shaken.

5184.name: Sentry Nutcracker
5184.description: A little nutcracker shaped after a core sentry in festive garment. Sadly there are no nuts around to be cracked.

5185.name: Winter Bell
5185.description: This golden and white bell produces a fine ringing sound, it's faint and reminds one of falling snow.

5186.name: Starwand Shaman Figurine
5186.description: A festive sculpture of a Starwand Shaman. It turns out that gingerbread and candy cane can become a surprisingly powerful combination!

5187.name: Snowhead Slime Figurine
5187.description: A festive, sculpted likeness of a Snowhead Slime. If you place it on top of two other snowballs, you might have an entire snowman.

5188.name: Carrot Slime Figurine
5188.description: A festive miniature of a Carrot Slime. Not the kind of snowball you'd recommend throwing.

5189.name: Bakery Brute Figurine
5189.description: A gingery sculpture of a Bakery Brute. It holds a rolling pin more as a weapon than a tool.

5190.name: Gingerbreadling Figurine
5190.description: A festive sculpture of a Gingerbreadling. Although it looks delicious, it might be best not to bite it.

5191.name: Santa Shrooman Figurine
5191.description: A festive representation of a Santa Shrooman. Ho-ho-honestly cute!

5192.name: Lump of Coal
5192.description: A dusty piece of coal that leaves your hands black and your conscience tainted. Have you perhaps been naughty?

5193.name: Pink Rose Bouquet
5193.description: This beautiful bouquet made from pink roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

5194.name: White Rose Bouquet
5194.description: This beautiful bouquet made from white roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

5195.name: Golden Rose Bouquet
5195.description: This beautiful bouquet made from golden roses will elevate the look of every room. Give it to someone you like dearly.

5196.name: Enchanted Rose
5196.description: To love another and earn their love in return.

5197.name: Rose Water
5197.description: A vial containing water and rose extract, said to make ones skin silky smooth and hair shiny.

5198.name: Heart of Gold
5198.description: Rewarded to those who truly look out for others and help whenever they can.

5199.name: Blue Glass Kalimba
5199.description: A delicate instrument that has multiple fractures across its surface, rendering it unusable. There is a signature reading "Woopsiee", that has been carved into the glass.

5200.name: Offspring Capsule
5200.description: A glass container containing an embryo suspended in nutritious liquid. It's blue with pointy ears but doesn't seem to be a caveling.

5201.name: Homeworld Reminiscence
5201.description: The replica of a blue, glistening planet, orbited by what seems to be three suns. Is this a model of a solar system?

5202.name: Catalyst Gemstone
5202.description: It looks like an Ancient Gemstone but seems to be extremely dense with energy. Has it been used to grow the Shimmering Frontier?

5203.name: Chemical Ration
5203.description: This box contains a strange, synthetic food source that doesn't appear safe for human consumption.

5204.name: Deepspace Log
5204.description: A thin glass tablet that displays a map of unfamiliar star constellations.

5205.name: Triops Fossil
5205.description: The petrified remains of a species that still exists to this day, even after 220 million years.

5206.name: Suspended Butterfly
5206.description: A fragile butterfly that has been completely corrupted by crystals.

5207.name: Crystal Bone
5207.description: All that's left of a creature that had the misfortune to stumble upon the Shimmering Frontier.

5208.name: Agartha Report
5208.description: A leatherbound book written in unsteady human language. It appears that the author believed to have found the mythological center of the earth, before succumbing to illness.

5209.name: Sparkle Opal
5209.description: A magnificent gemstone that glitters in pastel rainbow colors.

5210.name: Atlantean Worm Figurine
5210.description: A lifelike representation of the Atlantean Worm. How many of these exist, exactly?

5212.name: Mimite Figurine
5212.description: A miniature of a Mimite, the perfect mimicry of a small Sun Crystal.

5213.name: Orbital Turret Figurine
5213.description: A finely crafted representation of an Orbital Turret. It looks like a protective machine, but the real one might be too advanced to fully understand.

5214.name: Nilipede Figurine
5214.description: A tiny likeness of a Nilipede. Why does it always have to be worms?!

5215.name: Clay Burrower Figurine
5215.description: A tiny likeness of a Clay Burrower. Gladly, this one will not crawl out of a wall, so it's not as creepy as the real deal.

5216.name: Druidra Figurine
5216.description: A tiny likeness of Druidra the Wild Titan. If not for its glowing eyes, maybe it could completely merge with the surrounding nature.

5217.name: Pyrdra Figurine
5217.description: A tiny likeness of Pyrdra the Fire Titan. It's now just a reminder of the flying lava that once pursued you.

5218.name: Crydra Figurine
5218.description: A tiny likeness of Crydra the Ice Titan. Who knew ice could become so daunting?

5219.name: Core Commander Figurine
5219.description: A lifelike representation of the Core Commander. This is proof you have defeated the greatest foe and biggest threat you could imagine. Or is it?

5220.name: Unleashed Core Commander Figurine
5220.description: A rare miniature of the Unleashed Core Commander. A silhouette of the true form of the one that was left, attempting to make this place its home.

5221.name: Colossal Amoeba Figurine
5221.description: A tiny likeness of a Colossal Amoeba. Something like an organelle seems suspended at its center.

5222.name: Sulfur Worm Figurine
5222.description: A miniature of a Sulfur Worm. Thankfully, this one won't drop small bombs wherever it goes.

5223.name: Urschleim Figurine
5223.description: A tiny miniature of Urschleim. This primal slime mass seems to be unbothered by anything in its path.

5224.name: Caveling Mummy Figurine
5224.description: A miniature of a Caveling Mummy. Regardless if these are bandages or toilet paper, this fiend is super scary.

5225.name: Shrooman Brute Figurine
5225.description: A detailed miniature of a Shrooman Brute. Unlike its real counterpart, the entire surface of this sculpture feels rigid to the touch, not just the stone cap.

5226.name: Gold Scarab Figurine
5226.description: A miniature of a Gold Scarab, showcasing its golden skull-like wingcovers. Pareidolia is an amazing thing, isn't it?

5227.name: Cicada Nymph Figurine
5227.description: A lifelike representation of a Cicada Nymph, the nymph of what one day could have become a giant cicada... if it wasn't for someone.

5228.name: Floracada Figurine
5228.description: A lifelike representation of a Floracada, a giant cicada that burrows underground and guards its territory.

5229.name: Nimruza Figurine
5229.description: A lifelike representation of Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands. It depicts the carcass of what was once considered an incredible being.

5230.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Trophy
5230.description: A finely crafted representation of S.A.H.A.B.A.R. It resembles part of the herald that was one of the most advanced creations of an entire civilization.

5231.name: Void Larva Figurine
5231.description: A tiny sculpture of a Void Larva. The real ones attack in swarms, rushing their target with alarming speed.

5232.name: Void Larva Cocoon Figurine
5232.description: A miniature of a Void Larva Cocoon. Before seeing this, you thought nothing else could be more disgusting than a larva cocoon.

5233.name: Geobot Miner Figurine
5233.description: A detailed representation of a Geobot Miner. Very reminiscent of the rolling wheel that seems to love breaking walls and ramming into its enemies.

5234.name: Geobot Patroller Figurine
5234.description: A finely crafted miniature of a Geobot Patroller. It's a shame its siren lights can't be activated like the real ones do.

5235.name: Geobot Scourer Figurine
5235.description: A finely crafted representation of a Geobot Scourer. Thankfully this one seems to be very still, unlike its living counterpart.

5236.name: Void Caveling Figurine
5236.description: A sculpture of a Void Caveling. Somehow, it gives off the feeling that this species is not in full control of itself.

5237.name: Void Caveling Shaman Figurine
5237.description: This figurine depicts a Void Caveling Shaman. Thankfully, it cannot summon anything to destroy you.

5238.name: Void Caveling Brute Figurine
5238.description: A detailed representation of a Void Caveling Brute. The weight of the creature's steps is palpable just by looking at this figurine.

5239.name: Oblidra Figurine
5239.description: A miniature representation of Oblidra the Void Lord. And you thought three heads was too much...

5240.name: Wingling Figurine
5240.description: An interesting representation of a Wingling. A flying bat-like creature that seems to be very well-established in these caves.

5241.name: Searpent Figurine
5241.description: A shimmering representation of a Searpent. Its scales glimmer much clearer when above the surface of water.

5500.name: Mushroom
5500.description: A small cave mushroom, perfect for a snack on the go.

5502.name: Giant Mushroom
5502.description: The king of all mushrooms. Growing in perfect conditions made it unusually large.

5503.name: Amber Larva
5503.description: Grub encapsulated in amber, an extremely rare ingredient.

5504.name: Ravine Coral
5504.description: Fossilized coral found near the pits of the Undergrounds. Their alkaline aroma attracts winglings.

5505.name: Stone Moss
5505.description: Ground plants found in the Forgotten Ruins. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

5506.name: Lush Moss
5506.description: Ground plants found in Azeos' Wilderness. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

5507.name: Urban Moss
5507.description: Ground plants found in the Forlorn Metropolis. They grow tiny berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

5508.name: Fungal Soil
5508.description: Groundcover interspersed with mycelium. Over time mushrooms and shroomen will grow on it.

5509.name: Valley Moss
5509.description: Ground plants found in the Desert of Beginnings. They grow fragrant flowers that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

5510.name: Clay Moss
5510.description: Ground plants found in the Clay Caves. They grow aromatic berries that attract cavelings of the corresponding area.

5511.name: Chrysalis
5511.description: Icky groundcover that feels strange to walk across. Larvas will infest chrysalis-covered areas over time.

5512.name: Ground Slime
5512.description: Sticky material that slows down careless adventurers. Slime blobs will start to coagulate from slime covered surfaces over time.

5513.name: Ground Acid Slime
5513.description: Sticky material that slowly dissolves everything that touches it.

5514.name: Ground Poison Slime
5514.description: Sticky material that builds up toxin in the body.

5515.name: Ground Slippery Slime
5515.description: Slick material that makes it difficult to get a steady footing.

5516.name: Ground Magma Slime
5516.description: Sticky material mixed with magma that burns careless explorers.

5517.name: Crystal Crust
5517.description: A shimmering surface that attracts lifeforms found in crystalline environments.

5518.name: Ground Oil
5518.description: Sticky material that slows down and drenches careless adventurers in fire-hazardous oil.

5520.name: Ancient Crate
5520.description: A mysteriously glowing container holding ancient goods.

5570.name: Ruins Arc
5570.description: A giant stone slate that seemingly was once part of the ceiling. Tremors must have brought it down.

5571.name: Ruins Gate
5571.description: A toppled entrance made from carved stone and ancient gemstones. It seems to have been part of a sprawling city.

5572.name: Ruins Tile
5572.description: This thick stone tile features a pattern that looks like the core. It has been dislodged from the ground.

5573.name: Ruins Pillars
5573.description: Toppled over stone pillars that once supported a very high ceiling. When they fell, they must have caused a lot of destruction.

5580.name: Potted Land Algae
5580.description: A decorative version of the common Land Algae, planted in a driftwood pot.

5581.name: Potted Bloom Tree
5581.description: A potted shrub on which beautiful flowers grow. It seems to only exist in this form.

5582.name: Potted Plume Tree
5582.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common plume tree, planted in an ancient pot.

5583.name: Potted Cherry Tree
5583.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common cherry tree, planted in a decorative vase.

5584.name: Potted Lush Tree
5584.description: A shrub of the common Lush Tree, planted in a makeshift stone pot.

5585.name: Potted Mold Pompom
5585.description: An oversized, puffy flower that has been infested with mold.

5586.name: Potted Abyss Tree
5586.description: A tree that grows in the chasms of Azeos Wilderness, planted in a clay pot.

5587.name: Potted Magma Tulip
5587.description: A rare, decorative strain of a Glow Tulip that can withstand tremendous heat.

5588.name: Potted Moonbell Tree
5588.description: A potted shrub on which glowing flowers grow. It seems to only exist in this form.

5589.name: Potted Meadow Tree
5589.description: A bonsai-sized offshoot of the common meadow tree, planted in a wooden pot.

5590.name: Potted Lucent Oak
5590.description: A shrub of the magnificient Lucent Oak, growing from a naturally formed crystal pot.

5591.name: Potted Alien Flower
5591.description: It is not an actual flower but a hologram of one. Is it proof of a dying world where nothing grew anymore?

5601.name: Colossal Cicada Husk
5601.description: The cast-off husk of a giant insect that lives dormant in the ground for centuries. When it emerges to take on its final form, heavy earthquakes occur.

5609.name: Hive Growth
5609.description: A vein-like growth that reveals loot when popped open.

5611.name: Wooden Crate
5611.description: A wooden box used by someone to store random goods.

5612.name: Flower Vessel
5612.description: A yellow plant containing organic loot.

5616.name: Ancient Feather
5616.description: An unusual feather left by something big.

5619.name: Bush
5619.description: A stubby patch of grass to use as a decorative.

5620.name: Tall Grass
5620.description: A large patch of tall grass to use as a decorative.

5622.name: Lush Tree
5622.description: This verdant tree seems to have spent many years growing in an ancient forest. Plant it back into the ground to decorate your home.

5624.name: Camp Tent
5624.description: An abandoned makeshift tent, who would have lived here?

5625.name: Camp Mattress
5625.description: The resting place of a former adventurer?

5630.name: Mold Vessel
5630.description: A hollow, fuzzy fungus. Breaking it open may yield some useful goods.

5631.name: Large Mold Vessel
5631.description: A hollow and fuzzy fungal cluster. Breaking it open may yield some useful goods.

5636.name: Overgrown Wooden Crate
5636.description: A box that has been partially reclaimed by nature. It contains useful goods.

5639.name: Paradise Tree
5639.description: A giant jungle tree that seems to have grown from the essence of life itself. A must have decoration.

5640.name: Cicada Burrow
5640.description: A formidable tunneler dug this hollow.

5641.name: Fern
5641.description: A taiga-bound plant with even rows of leaves.

5642.name: Evergreen Shrub
5642.description: A small berry bush with vibrant green leaves. It is unfortunately sparse on berries.

5643.name: Moorshroom
5643.description: A fungus with shimmer under its crusty cap, thick with moisture.

5646.name: Small Pine Tree
5646.description: An evergreen tree adapted to survive without sunlight... Just like most other trees down here.

5647.name: Mossy Soil
5647.description: Mat of moss interspersed with mycelium. Over time moss mushrooms will grow on it.

5648.name: Stoneware Pot
5648.description: An earthy container with green vegetation between its old cracks.

5649.name: Large Stoneware Pot
5649.description: A thick earthy container with green vegetation between its old cracks.

5650.name: Tall Pine Tree
5650.description: A tall evergreen tree adapted to survive without sunlight... Just like most other trees down here.

5700.name: Caveling Floor Tile
5700.description: A crumbly stone slab with simple patterns embedded in it.

5701.name: Broken Stone Pillar
5701.description: Unstable pillar for decoration, probably thousands of years old.

5702.name: Caveling Pot
5702.description: An urn made from stone filled with the belongings of cavelings.

5703.name: Caveling Table
5703.description: A crude, blocky piece of furniture, many meals must have been shared on it.

5705.name: Caveling Toilet
5705.description: Between mining there must be time for serious business.

5709.name: Water Well
5709.description: An ancient stone well to take water from.

5710.name: Dark Caveling Floor Tile
5710.description: A dark version of the ancient floor tiles, it looks much older.

5711.name: Caveling Throne
5711.description: This unusual seat is proof of an empire fallen to ruin.

5712.name: Roast Firepit
5712.description: Part fireplace, part barbecue. It is a great place to huddle together and enjoy some burned pieces of larva meat.

5713.name: Larva Skewer
5713.description: A pretty cruel way of stacking up meat for later use.

5714.name: Larvaskin Tent
5714.description: This simple type of housing must have used many skins of larva. There are patches of other creatures thrown in too.

5715.name: Spear Rack
5715.description: A crudely-made rack that is used by cavelings to have their spears at the ready.

5716.name: Broken Clay Kiln
5716.description: Having seen many years of use this old kiln is beyond repair.

5717.name: Clay Firing Bucket
5717.description: A simple gadget that was used to burn clay and make it harder.

5718.name: Larvaskin Rug
5718.description: This gross rug doubles down as a trophy for the hunted larva that provided their skin.

5719.name: Hive Larvaskin Rug
5719.description: This gross rug doubles down as a trophy for the hunted hive larva that provided their skin.

5720.name: Small Clamping Frame
5720.description: This small wooden frame made use of even the tiniest larva to turn its skin into leather.

5721.name: Clamping Frame
5721.description: This wooden frame has been used to stretch larva skin and manufacture it into leather.

5722.name: Clay Pot
5722.description: A crude container that's already almost broken. Smash it to relieve it of its contents.

5750.name: Mold Tree
5750.description: A once green tree that is thoroughly infected with mold.

5751.name: Mold Well
5751.description: You surely don't want to water your plants with its contents.

5752.name: Mold Pillar
5752.description: An ancient pillar featuring the core, it is overgrown by mold.

5753.name: Mold Cicada (Sickle)
5753.description: A colossal cicada that died before it could cast off its hull. It looks like it got infected with an aggressive mold that caused it to run rampant.

5771.name: Rust Pile
5771.description: Debris of mechanical junk found in the Breaker's Reach. It attracts Geobots of the corresponding area.

5772.name: Muddled Moss
5772.description: Groundcover interspersed with purplish mycelium. Over time it grows glowing mushrooms, and attracts beings from the void.

5773.name: Glowing Mushroom
5773.description: A bitter, pungent mushroom that brightens up murky caves.

5775.name: Broken Geobot Patroller
5775.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

5776.name: Broken Geobot Charger
5776.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

5777.name: Decrepit Geobot Charger
5777.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

5778.name: Broken Geobot Swarmer
5778.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

5779.name: Decrepit Geobot Swarmer
5779.description: The worn down remnants of a once operational and vigilant robot.

5800.name: Beached Jelly
5800.description: A gelatinous creature containing goods from the sea.

5803.name: Land Algae
5803.description: A type of algae that can grow outside of water.

5804.name: Tall Land Algae
5804.description: A large type of algae that can grow outside of water.

5805.name: Kelp Tree
5805.description: It's technically not a tree but a giant kelp with a double-helix coral as a trunk.

5806.name: Fishing Net Rack
5806.description: A loose net thrown across some stakes to dry in the air.

5807.name: Driftwood Table
5807.description: Someone made this from materials floating in the water.

5808.name: Driftwood Stool
5808.description: A simple stool made with beach materials.

5809.name: Wooden Sign "Core"
5809.description: Driftwood with patterns and carvings showing the Core.

5810.name: Wooden Sign "Tulip"
5810.description: Driftwood with patterns and carvings showing a Glow Tulip.

5819.name: Metropolis Gate
5819.description: An intact stone gate found at the forlorn metropolis. It stands tall and must have dazzled visitors with the giant ancient gemstone in its center.

5820.name: Core Relief Tile
5820.description: A giant, gold-rimmed stone tile, depicting a rendition of the core.

5821.name: Gemstone Stone Tile
5821.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a glowing gemstone.

5822.name: Cavelings Stone Tile
5822.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a gathering of cavelings.

5823.name: Scholar Stone Tile
5823.description: A giant stone tile decorated with a deep blue glass. It depicts a robed caveling.

5824.name: Small Holoboard
5824.description: A vertical panel made from blue glass. The flickering glyphs on it almost appear like a city map.

5825.name: Large Holoboard
5825.description: A vertical large panel made from blue glass. The flickering glyphs on it almost appear like some kind of advertisement.

5826.name: Broken Holoboard
5826.description: A broken panel made from blue glass. It's hard to make out the flickering glyphs on it.

5827.name: Big Gold-edged Table
5827.description: A big sturdy table hewn from a giant stone slab. There is a lot of space for many people.

5828.name: Gold-edged Table
5828.description: A sturdy table hewn from a giant stone slab. There is a lot of space for many people.

5829.name: Caveling Stool
5829.description: This stool is made from solid stone but has a comfortable cushion embedded.

5830.name: Stone Shelf
5830.description: A solid shelf with lots of space for books and scrolls. The ones left in it are unintelligible.

5831.name: Large Stone Shelf
5831.description: A large solid shelf with lots of space for books and scrolls. The ones left in it are written in a language you don't speak.

5832.name: Caveling Fireplace
5832.description: A solid fireplace with a heavy mantle. It burns with a strange fire that emanates from a gemstone on its bottom.

5833.name: Caveling Pillar
5833.description: A broad stone pillar, depicting an abstract caveling.

5834.name: Vending Machine
5834.description: An old, still functioning automaton that is proof of advanced technology and a sophisticated society.

5835.name: Broken Vending Machine
5835.description: A broken automaton that once contained snacks and other goods. It looks like it was forced open.

5837.name: Sea Shell
5837.description: A strange shell with a silky-smooth surface.

5840.name: Metropolis Crate
5840.description: This precious container holds useful items that have been used by citizens of the ancient city.

5842.name: Driftwood Wooden Crate
5842.description: This box has been created from driftwood and is bleached by light from above.

5844.name: Large Bicolor Coral
5844.description: A large group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

5845.name: Bicolor Coral
5845.description: A group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

5846.name: Small Bicolor Coral
5846.description: A small group of two coral species that grow together to form a symbiosis.

5847.name: Large Crimson Coral
5847.description: A large branchy coral that provides protection and food for small sea critters.

5848.name: Crimson Coral
5848.description: A small branchy coral that provides protection and food for small sea critters.

5849.name: Large Dish Coral
5849.description: A large coral that develops a wide brim above the water surface, providing a safe island for small organisms.

5850.name: Dish Coral
5850.description: A small coral that develops a wide brim above the water surface, providing a safe island for small organisms.

5860.name: Desert Flower Vessel
5860.description: A dry plant containing natural loot from the desert.

5863.name: Charred Crate
5863.description: This grand wooden crate has been blackened by a scorching environment.

5864.name: Temple Crate
5864.description: An ancient crate filled with goods of an old desert civilization.

5866.name: Oasis Flower Vessel
5866.description: A healthy plant containing natural loot from the desert.

5868.name: Desert Shrub
5868.description: A dry bush that can live hundreds of years without water.

5870.name: Large Left-Facing Rock Arc
5870.description: A large sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

5871.name: Giant Right-Facing Rock Arc
5871.description: A giant sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

5874.name: Plume Tree
5874.description: This tree has rock-hard bark and deep roots to gain and hold water from the desert grounds. Its leaves grow in puffy bundles.

5878.name: Scarab Wingcover
5878.description: The wing carapace of a Bomb Scarab resembling half a skull.

5881.name: Temple Pillar
5881.description: A very beautiful, decorative pillar only found in ancient desert temples.

5882.name: Angled Glyph Wall
5882.description: An ancient sandstone wall with an angled top and covered in indecipherable glyphs. What stories do they tell?

5883.name: Glyph Wall
5883.description: An ancient sandstone wall covered in indecipherable glyphs. What stories do they tell?

5884.name: Temple Decor Rug
5884.description: A small, ancient rug caked with the dust of thousands of years. The design on it shows a trinity of eyes.

5885.name: Large Temple Decor Rug
5885.description: A large, ancient rug with a very detailed design woven into it. It must once have been an expensive item and a sign of prosperity.

5886.name: Temple Guardian Statue
5886.description: This intimidating statue depicts an ancient guardian in exotic garment. Its kneeling pose hints at being in service of a king.

5887.name: Raided Temple Guardian Statue
5887.description: A statue wilfully destroyed by grave thiefs. It has been partially relieved of the green daggers in its stony clasp.

5888.name: Glyph Stele
5888.description: A block made from hazy blue glass with golden etchings. It seems like these were used as memorials or to mark places of importance.

5889.name: Broken Glyph Stele
5889.description: A block made from hazy blue glass with golden etchings. The information written on it is lost forever as it has been smashed on purpose.

5900.name: Temple Throne
5900.description: A golden throne reserved only for the buttocks of ancient royalty.

5901.name: Temple Pedestal
5901.description: An ancient golden stand that seems to have held royal belongings once.

5902.name: Azeos Urn
5902.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Azeos, the Sky Titan.

5903.name: Ra-Akar Urn
5903.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Ra-Akar, the Sand Titan.

5904.name: Omoroth Urn
5904.description: This decorative vase has been made in honor of Omoroth, the Sea Titan.

5908.name: Raided Grave
5908.description: Its emptiness is proof of the blasphemous acts of grave raiders.

5909.name: Damaged Grave
5909.description: A partially broken grave that either survived the currents of time or a quick attempt to gain treasure.

5910.name: Servant Grave
5910.description: This grave made from stone shows the relief of an ancient caveling in service of the kingdom that once persisted in the desert.

5911.name: Tilted Grave
5911.description: An empty grave that has been moved out of its alignment in search for valuables.

5916.name: Lava Rock
5916.description: You're not sure why you did this...but at least you now have a very hot rock.

5917.name: Coal Pit
5917.description: Ashen residue suggests it was once used to temper metal in its fires for many years.

5918.name: Old Smithing Bellow
5918.description: An old device used to circulate air into a forge to create extreme temperatures. The lever for its mechanism is rusted in place.

5919.name: Broken Quarry Timber
5919.description: One half of a broken wooden construction that seemed to have once held something in place.

5920.name: Large Quarry Timber
5920.description: A wooden construction used to keep ore and rocks above a fire. A surge in temperatures rendered it unusable.

5921.name: Old Wheelbarrow
5921.description: A broken wheelbarrow stuck in its own molten contents. It seems like it couldn't withstand the extreme heat.

5922.name: Large Right-Facing Rock Arc
5922.description: A large sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

5923.name: Giant Left-Facing Rock Arc
5923.description: A giant sandstone arc, you're not exactly sure how it fits in your backpack.

5925.name: Amalgam Basin
5925.description: A natural rock formation with volcanic activity. Its connection to the earth's depths allowed it to form a special kind of metal.

5926.name: Amalgam Vent
5926.description: A side-formation of the Amalgam Basin that gets rid of built up heat.

5928.name: Herald Void Neuron
5928.description: A glowing cell that phases through itself, twisted and pulled as if tethered to an unseen presence. Once part of S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s containment core, it now transmits a distorted echo of the same signal.

5940.name: Alien Tech Crate
5940.description: A breakable box that is not from this world. It contains extraterrestrial goods.

5941.name: Large Alien Tech Destructible
5941.description: A breakable storage unit that is not from this world. It contains extraterrestrial goods.

5945.name: Sun Crystal
5945.description: A fragile crystal growth that shimmers like the sun. You can see items encased within.

5946.name: Large Sun Crystal
5946.description: A tall but fragile crystal cluster that shimmers like the sun. You can see items encased within.

5947.name: Failed Titan
5947.description: A rare specimen of a colossal cicada that would have become a titan. But due to becoming corrupted with crystals inside its husk, it died when it tried to finally emerge.

5949.name: Lucent Oak
5949.description: What once seemed to have been a normal tree got permeated by crystals, turning it into a living work of art.

5950.name: Tall Crystal Grass
