5950.description: A tall, strange growth that consists of broad, transparent leaves.

5951.name: Crystal Grass
5951.description: A strange growth that consists of broad, transparent leaves.

5952.name: Crystal Tent
5952.description: The crystallized, makeshift resting place of a former explorer. They don't have much use for each other anymore.

5953.name: Radiation Crystal
5953.description: A culmination of radioactive elements that resulted in a glass-like structure.

5954.name: Geode Wall Display
5954.description: A cleanly cut half of a geode. The simple wooden construction underneath allows it to be attached to a wall.

5955.name: Small Obelisk
5955.description: A descriptive stele, carved into stone. The runes on it are indecipherable.

5956.name: Tall Obelisk
5956.description: A large descriptive stele, carved into stone. The runes on it are indecipherable.

5957.name: Singing Crystal
5957.description: Due to its shape, this naturally formed crystal rings with a harmonic frequency when struck.

5958.name: Dysfunctional Coil
5958.description: A piece of alien technology that seems to have burned out.

5959.name: Alien Crystal Light
5959.description: A highly advanced light using a giant ancient gemstone. It almost appears like an oversized torch made for something with even larger hands.

5960.name: Alien Floor Vent
5960.description: A piece of tech that would still be functional, had it not been ripped out of the floor by greedy hands.

5961.name: Small Alien Obelisk
5961.description: A descriptive stele, carved into mysterious stone. Its meaning is beyond earthly understanding.

5962.name: Tall Alien Obelisk
5962.description: A large descriptive stele, carved into mysterious stone. Its meaning is beyond earthly understanding.

5970.name: Sulfur Tree
5970.description: This gnarled tree feasts on the organic matter of the passage. It sprouts glowing sacs of toxic gas.

5971.name: Sulfur Bud
5971.description: A sapling grows inside this fragile bulb of toxic gas. The lightest touch can make it burst!

5972.name: Purple Feather Tree
5972.description: Not a tree at all, but a tall invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its long arms.

5973.name: Small Purple Feather Tree
5973.description: Not a tree at all, but an invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its arms. It hasn't fully matured yet.

5974.name: Cyan Feather Tree
5974.description: Not a tree at all, but a tall invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its long arms.

5975.name: Small Cyan Feather Tree
5975.description: Not a tree at all, but an invertebrate feeding on floating particles with its arms. It hasn't fully matured yet.

5976.name: Tall Barnacle Grass
5976.description: A large group of long-necked barnacles stretching out from the ground.

5977.name: Barnacle Grass
5977.description: A small group of long-necked barnacles stretching out from the ground.

5979.name: Pandorium Crystal
5979.description: This large crystal formation pops and sputters with chaotic energy.

5980.name: Small Pandorium Crystal
5980.description: This small crystal formation pops and sputters with chaotic energy.

5981.name: Fossil Cluster
5981.description: Stacks of calcified marine fossils. There may be some resources inside.

5982.name: Large Fossil Cluster
5982.description: A heaping pile of calcified marine fossils. There may be some resources inside.

5983.name: Rift Statue
5983.description: This statue opens a rift to a mysterious entity. It seems willing to trade.

5985.name: Grimy Stone Pillar
5985.description: This sullied pillar is covered in intricate... monstrous carvings.

5986.name: Grimy Stone Floor
5986.description: A floor made of dark, grimy stone bricks.

5987.name: Stone Lantern
5987.description: An unknown light source sits inside this solid stone cage. The air around it feels cold.

5988.name: Oasis Stalagmite
5988.description: A solid humid pillar, coated with adrift red sand settling over the centuries.

5990.name: Gilded Aloe
5990.description: This lovely succulent has not yet fully bloomed.

5991.name: Large Gilded Aloe
5991.description: A resilient succulent that thrives in humid environments.

5992.name: Water Reed
5992.description: Has a sweet smelling pollen irresistible to insects.

5993.name: Colossal Cicada
5993.description: A fully grown colossal cicada that seems to have met an unfortunate end.

6002.name: Tombstone
6002.description: Now that the worst is over, use it to decorate!

6500.name: Lever
6500.description: Generates a low amount of electricity that can be turned on and off.

6501.name: Electrical Wire
6501.description: Connects sources of electricity to machines and apparatuses.

6504.name: Electrical Door
6504.description: Opens up when powered by electricity.

6505.name: Logic Circuit
6505.description: Electricity can move through the circuit when it receives electricity on exactly 2 out of 3 inputs.

6507.name: Delay Circuit
6507.description: Stores electricity input and sends it out during intervals of 1 second.

6508.name: Electricity Stick
6508.description: Emits a very low electricity that is too low to power up objects but useful to change behavior of logic circuits.

6509.name: Dynamite Pack
6509.description: This tight pack of explosives can be detonated in safety with an external trigger.

6510.name: Pressure Plate
6510.description: Generates a low amount of electricity when stepped on by the player.

6511.name: Cross Circuit
6511.description: Separates horizontal and vertical wires. Allows crossing wires without connecting the electricity. Connection directions change by rotating the circuit while holding it.

6512.name: Materializer
6512.description: This incredible device is able to weave free matter into a temporary living being when charged with electricity. Requires a figurine as blueprint.

6514.name: Ancient Waypoint
6514.description: A miraculous gemstone device used to teleport to other waypoints and portals. When placed, it takes 10 minutes to charge up before it can be accessed.

6515.name: Remote Explosive Pack
6515.description: A neat pack of boom, remote-operated and safety-approved... probably. Don’t lose the remote.

6516.name: Pressure Pedestal
6516.description: Generates a low amount of electricity when an item is placed upon it.

6517.name: Explorer Proximity Sensor
6517.description: A sensor that responds to the presence of humans.

6518.name: Lowered Electricity Generator
6518.description: Powers wires and objects with electricity and is beneath floor-level.

6519.name: Electrical Drop Gate
6519.description: Opens from below when powered by electricity. Can be placed in water and doesn't require walls.

6520.name: Enemy Proximity Sensor
6520.description: A sensor that responds to the presence of hostile creatures.

6521.name: Kinematic Dynamo
6521.description: Emits a low charge of electricity when struck. Equally sturdy and responsive.

6522.name: T Circuit
6522.description: A circuit that takes directs electricity from 1 direction into 2 other directions.

6523.name: L Circuit
6523.description: A circuit that directs electricity through a right angle.

6524.name: I Circuit
6524.description: A circuit that directs electricity in a straight line exclusively.

6550.name: Rail
6550.description: Traverse the underground world much faster.

6551.name: Minecart
6551.description: Allows riding the railways with high speed.

6581.name: Speeder
6581.description: Allows traveling over water much faster.

6590.name: Speeder Go-Kart
6590.description: A racing kart with a nice red finish, able to outrace other vehicles after a longer acceleration time. Tends to drift a lot when driving too fast.

6591.name: Renegade Go-Kart
6591.description: An off-road vehicle that provides quick acceleration but lower top-speed. It looks slightly busted but lets you take curves in a more stable manner.

6592.name: Primitive Go-Kart
6592.description: An ancient vehicle built by the lost civilization, seemingly for pure fun. It provides only a fraction of the speed it once was capable of.

6600.name: Hive Spike Trap
6600.description: A larva hive trap made out of sharp bones, damaging any creature who steps on it.

6601.name: Spike Trap
6601.description: A mechanical spike trap that only reacts to enemies.

6604.name: Poison Spike Trap
6604.description: A mechanical spike trap that reacts to anyone stepping on it and additionally applies poison when inflicting damage.

6609.name: Galaxite Trap
6609.description: This high-tech trap shoots out a jet of energy that burns with different temperatures, resulting in a rainbow flame.

6610.name: Wooden Spike Trap
6610.description: A crude spike trap that only reacts to enemies.

6650.name: Drill
6650.description: Can slowly drill through tougher materials such as ore boulders when powered by electricity. Drills drilling together yield better results.

6652.name: Robot Arm
6652.description: A mechanical helping hand, grabs things and puts them elsewhere when powered by electricity. Filtering can be enabled to only handle matching items.

6653.name: Sprinkler
6653.description: A useful gadget that waters tilled ground in a small radius.

6654.name: Stone Turret
6654.description: This ancient trap shoots projectiles at anyone walking into its line of sight. Its inner workings are concealed by a caveling grimace.

6655.name: Galaxite Turret
6655.description: An automated high-tech gun that shoots enemies it faces with energy projectiles. Requires electricity to function.

6656.name: Crude Drill
6656.description: Can very slowly drill through tougher materials such as ore boulders when powered by electricity. Drills drilling together yield better results.

6657.name: Seed Extractor
6657.description: Extracts and reclaims seeds from plants when powered by electricity.

6658.name: Robot Farm Arm
6658.description: A mechanical farm arm that plants seeds and harvests crops when powered by electricity. Does not drop seeds, unlike manual harvest.

6660.name: Shredder
6660.description: When powered by electricity, automatically scraps tools, equipment and other things you don't need.

6661.name: Incinerator
6661.description: Processes items to be forever destroyed when powered by electricity.

6662.name: Item Collector
6662.description: Collects items within its detection range when powered by electricity.

6663.name: Flame Turret
6663.description: Continuously sprays fire in its facing direction while powered. Requires electricity to function.

6800.name: Grimy Bookshelf
6800.description: A set of stony rows lined with worn jagged books.

6801.name: Large Grimy Bookshelf
6801.description: A grand shelf hosting a vast library of grayed tomes.

6803.name: Grimy Table
6803.description: A dimly moss-colored table with dust sticking to its damp surface.

6820.name: Makeshift Goggles
6820.description: Monocular night vision made from various scientific gadgetry.

6821.name: Researcher's Coat
6821.description: A specialized lab coat faintly tinged with radiation. It's probably harmless.

6822.name: Researcher's Pants
6822.description: A pair of pale leggings designed to idle on office chairs, yet perfectly fit for outrunning extradimensional horrors.

6823.name: Whiteboard
6823.description: A whiteboard covered with convoluted, scribbled equations.

6824.name: Water Cooler
6824.description: A jug-based water cooler, great for holding and dispensing liquids.

6825.name: Bottled Anomaly
6825.description: Contains an indecipherable entity that appears to respond to glass.

6826.name: Snacks Vending Machine
6826.description: A snack dispenser with contents in surprisingly fresh condition.

6827.name: Office Crate
6827.description: A box arbitrarily stocked with research items.

6829.name: Pipe Club
6829.description: A hefty pipe with a gauge on the end for added weight.

6830.name: Quill Rifle
6830.description: A re-engineered bioweapon, discharging quills as deadly bolts.

6832.name: Rootbear
6832.description: This soda tastes like licorice, or something worse.

6834.name: Slushie
6834.description: An ice cold beverage with a kick of flavor. May cause a slight chill.

6835.name: Mug of Coffee
6835.description: A highly caffeinated drink. Sure to knock some fatigue off.

6836.name: Kizz Cola
6836.description: A strange soda, from a strange vending machine.

6837.name: Anteverse Portal
6837.description: Gadgetry labeled "GATE" that suspends a humming entryway. The rims of its rift depict a laboratorial place of origin, which has been eclipsed by a tether to the Core.

6840.name: Electro-Pest Figurine
6840.description: A miniature model of an Electro-Pest. It depicts a creature that seems to have come from someplace unfamiliar.

6848.name: Superior Ward Coil
6848.description: This object emits a very vast warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

6849.name: Greater Ward Coil
6849.description: This object emits a vast warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

6850.name: Ward Coil
6850.description: This object emits a warding zone, imbuing structures inside with aberrant permanence. It prevents object placement, destruction, and limits interaction.

6851.name: Explosive Barrel
6851.description: A barrel packed with unstable materials. The seal is holding, but it feels like it’s only a matter of time.

6852.name: Wall Thermostat
6852.description: Measures heat... while in doing so emitting its own.

6853.name: Wall Gauge
6853.description: Measures the thickness of the wall behind it, though its hand fluctuates.

6854.name: Wall Metal Sheet
6854.description: Haphazard sheets bolted with screws used for a last-ditch-effort of patchwork.

6858.name: Excavation Sign
6858.description: A fancy brass-coated waymark for the lost.

6859.name: Metal Barrel
6859.description: A barrel for hazardous waste. It is firmly sealed for better or worse.

6860.name: Reinforced Industrial Box
6860.description: A metallic box once meant for tool storage. Its reinforcement has rusted and weakened over time.

6861.name: Metal Industrial Box
6861.description: A metallic box once meant for tool storage. Its previously sturdy latches have deteriorated over time.

6862.name: Metal Barricade
6862.description: A reliable metal barricade keeping curiosity and chaos apart.

6863.name: Metal Pallet
6863.description: A heavy metal pallet built for hauling gear and supplies.

6864.name: Dull Tree
6864.description: A dreary tree with crooked branches that have long lost its leaves.

6865.name: Column Monument
6865.description: A tall, dusty pillar decorated with sigils of crossed hammers.

6866.name: Sahabar Monument
6866.description: A majestic likeness of a prophet holding a pickaxe cast in copper.

6867.name: Gear Monument
6867.description: A sculpted cog given sanctified portrayal.

6868.name: Drill Monument
6868.description: A sculpted drill given sanctified portrayal.

6869.name: Plain Chest
6869.description: Who ever said storage containers need to be complex?

6870.name: Pious Caveling Monument
6870.description: A colossal statue of a caveling in vaguely monastic garb. Its decorative bright gems still glow in the dark.

6871.name: Industrial Pedestal
6871.description: A steelclad pedestal with hints of rust. Nobody would place something hazardous atop something so accessible, right?

6872.name: Aether Candelabra
6872.description: A tall candelabrum hosting three candlelike burners. Its esoteric material emits a purple flame.

6873.name: Geobot Leg
6873.description: A geobot's discarded limb, somehow in excellent condition. It has just enough charge left to curl and splay on its own.

6874.name: Disabled Datapad
6874.description: A beeping tablet that won't respond to your inputs. Someone else might find use for it.

6875.name: Sahabar Idol
6875.description: A small totem with gilded details in the likeness of a prophet. To some its price would be too sacred to place. To others it is high.

6876.name: Oblidra Chest
6876.description: An intimidating chest that's reminiscent of Oblidra the Void Lord.

7100.name: Azeos Feather Fan
7100.description: A beautiful fan created in honor of Azeos that appears to create wind without swinging it. A gift worthy of a queen.

7200.name: Omoroth Compass
7200.description: A splendid tool for seafaring created in honor of Omoroth, anyone possessing it will never feel lost at sea. A gift worthy of a king.

7300.name: Ra-Akar Automaton
7300.description: A complex wind-up machine created in honor of Ra-Akar that seems to have a mind of its own. A gift worthy of a young prince.

7400.name: Harp
7400.description: Simply gliding the fingertips across its fine strings results in a harmonic sound vibrating through the air.

7401.name: Cello
7401.description: A string instrument made from wood. It's not a world-class creation but good enough to fill the silent caves with harmony.

7402.name: Flute
7402.description: A fine wind instrument producing a whistling sound. Can be tricky to master.

7403.name: Drumkit
7403.description: An instrument that annoys the neighbors but induces irresistible rhythm when played correctly.

7404.name: Pocket Piano
7404.description: This transportable key instrument can be played solo or as a nice addition to an orchestra.

7900.name: Meadow Milk
7900.description: A bottle of milk with a slight vanilla aroma and an earthy aftertaste.

7901.name: Marbled Meat
7901.description: A thick slab of meat, waiting to be simmered and seasoned.

7902.name: Dodo Egg
7902.description: A large egg protected by an ivory shell. Safe for consumption!

7903.name: Orex Truffle
7903.description: A gaseous fungus found by an Orex. Cooking would surely bring out its earthy taste.

8001.name: Heart Berry Seed
8001.description: Grows into a healthy fruit when planted.

8003.name: Heart Berry
8003.description: A sweet, juicy berry that refreshes the body.

8004.name: Glow Tulip Seed
8004.description: Grows into a luminescent flower when planted.

8006.name: Glow Tulip
8006.description: A precious, shimmering flower that absorbed ancient energy.

8007.name: Bomb Pepper Seed
8007.description: Grows into a spicy vegetable when planted.

8009.name: Bomb Pepper
8009.description: A fierce vegetable for spicing up foods.

8010.name: Carrock Seed
8010.description: A tough seed that only grows in prepared stone.

8012.name: Carrock
8012.description: Rock-hard vegetable that toughens you up.

8013.name: Puffungi Seed
8013.description: A seed that only grows in prepared mold.

8015.name: Puffungi
8015.description: A moldy fungus fit for gourmets.

8016.name: Root Seed
8016.description: Once planted it spreads roots in every direction.

8018.name: Grub Kapok Seed
8018.description: Turns into a plant that gives fiber when harvested.

8020.name: Coral Wood Seed
8020.description: Once planted it spreads corals in every direction. Can only be planted on prepared beach sand.

8022.name: Bloat Oat Seed
8022.description: Grows into a filling crop when planted.

8024.name: Bloat Oat
8024.description: A handful of healthy cereal that fills you up and gives you energy.

8025.name: Pewpaya Seed
8025.description: Grows into a juicy fruit when planted in beach sand.

8027.name: Pewpaya
8027.description: A juicy, sweet fruit that clears your mind and raises focus.

8028.name: Pinegrapple Seed
8028.description: Grows into a refreshing sour and sweet fruit when planted in prepared beach sand.

8030.name: Pinegrapple
8030.description: An intensely tasty fruit that has you clench your weapons tightly.

8031.name: Grumpkin Seed
8031.description: Grows into a lumpy fruit when planted.

8033.name: Grumpkin
8033.description: A lumpy fruit that looks very annoyed with having been pulled from the soil.

8034.name: Sunrice Seed
8034.description: Grows into a bracing crop when planted. Only grows in prepared crystal ground.

8036.name: Sunrice
8036.description: A vibrant crop that braces you for tough encounters.

8037.name: Lunacorn Seed
8037.description: Grows into an inspiriting crop when planted. Only grows in prepared crystal ground.

8039.name: Lunacorn
8039.description: A mealy, colorful crop that increases your toughness.

8040.name: Gleam Wood Seed
8040.description: Once planted it spreads glowing roots in every direction. Can only be planted on prepared crystal ground.

8100.name: Golden Heart Berry
8100.description: A very rare variant of the common heart berry.

8101.name: Golden Glow Tulip
8101.description: A very rare variant of the common glow tulip.

8102.name: Golden Bomb Pepper
8102.description: A very rare variant of the common bomb pepper.

8103.name: Golden Carrock
8103.description: A very rare variant of the common carrock.

8104.name: Golden Puffungi
8104.description: A very rare variant of the common puffungi.

8105.name: Golden Bloat Oat
8105.description: A very rare variant of the common bloat oat.

8106.name: Golden Pewpaya
8106.description: A very rare variant of the common pewpaya.

8107.name: Golden Pinegrapple
8107.description: A very rare variant of the common pinegrapple.

8108.name: Golden Grumpkin
8108.description: A very rare variant of the common grumpkin.

8109.name: Golden Sunrice
8109.description: A very rare variant of the common sunrice.

8110.name: Golden Lunacorn
8110.description: A very rare variant of the common lunacorn.

8200.name: Recall Idol
8200.description: Teleports you back to the core, consumed in the process.

8210.name: Hive Mother Scanner
8210.description: Scans the world for the Hive Mother. Consumed on successful scan.

8211.name: Ghorm the Devourer Scanner
8211.description: Scans the world for Ghorm the Devourer. Consumed on successful scan.

8212.name: Malugaz the Corrupted Scanner
8212.description: Scans the world for Malugaz the Corrupted. Consumed on successful scan.

8220.name: Azeos the Sky Titan Scanner
8220.description: Scans the world for Azeos the Sky Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8221.name: Ivy the Poisonous Mass Scanner
8221.description: Scans the world for Ivy the Poisonous Mass. Consumed on successful scan.

8225.name: Omoroth the Sea Titan Scanner
8225.description: Scans the world for Omoroth the Sea Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8226.name: Morpha the Aquatic Mass Scanner
8226.description: Scans the world for Morpha the Aquatic Mass. Consumed on successful scan.

8227.name: Ra-Akar the Sand Titan Scanner
8227.description: Scans the world for Ra-Akar the Sand Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8228.name: Igneous the Molten Mass Scanner
8228.description: Scans the world for Igneous the Molten Mass. Consumed on successful scan.

8229.name: Atlantean Worm Scanner
8229.description: Scans the world for the Atlantean Worm. Consumed on successful scan.

8230.name: Core Commander Scanner
8230.description: Scans the world for the Core Commander. Consumed on successful scan.

8231.name: Druidra the Wild Titan Scanner
8231.description: Scans the world for Druidra the Wild Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8232.name: Crydra the Ice Titan Scanner
8232.description: Scans the world for Crydra the Ice Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8233.name: Pyrdra the Fire Titan Scanner
8233.description: Scans the world for Pyrdra the Fire Titan. Consumed on successful scan.

8234.name: Urschleim Scanner
8234.description: Scans the world for Urschleim. Consumed on successful scan.

8235.name: Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands Scanner
8235.description: Scans the world for Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands. Consumed on successful scan.

8250.name: Rune Parchment
8250.description: An unusually well preserved piece of ancient paper. The runes are impossible to decipher but small symbols hint at it being the recipe for a strange weapon.

8251.name: Glyph Parchment
8251.description: An unusually well preserved piece of ancient paper. There are glyphs and images on it that show how to forge a powerful ancient weapon.

8252.name: Empty Crystal
8252.description: A rhombus-shaped crystal made from glass that has complex circuits embedded. It seems powered down, maybe it could be fed data to activate it again?

8253.name: Admin Key
8253.description: A reactivated key belonging to a wise leader. It may open the door to something very valuable.

8254.name: Cipher Parchment
8254.description: An unusually well preserved scroll made from golden paper. Among the blue edged runes are drawings of an ancient forge resembling the face of a caveling.

8255.name: Thread of Fate
8255.description: A mysterious string woven from fine filaments. It can be used to bind a set of cards together.

8257.name: Schematic Parchment
8257.description: A well preserved but complicated blueprint. Its pictographs with exotic numerals outline steps in assembling a devastating weapon.

8259.name: Oblidra the Void Lord Scanner
8259.description: Scans the world for Oblidra the Void Lord. Consumed on successful scan.

8260.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Scanner
8260.description: Scans the world for S.A.H.A.B.A.R. Consumed on successful scan.

8262.name: Stillwater Echo-Map
8262.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8263.name: Runic Echo-Map
8263.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8265.name: Phantasmal Echo-Map
8265.description: A disc with coordinates for a sealed chamber. Consumed on successful scan.

8267.name: Fateful Echo-Map
8267.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8269.name: Verdant Echo-Map
8269.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8270.name: Gelid Echo-Map
8270.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8271.name: Pyric Echo-Map
8271.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8280.name: Sacred Echo-Map
8280.description: A disc with coordinates for three sealed treasures. Consumed on successful scan.

8281.name: Veil Echo-Map
8281.description: A disc with coordinates of significance. Consumed on successful scan.

8300.name: Lantern
8300.description: A small, useful light that leaves your hands free.

8301.name: Orb Lantern
8301.description: A better, brighter source of light to attach to your belt.

8302.name: Small Lantern
8302.description: A weak light to attach to your belt.

8303.name: Pumpkin Lantern
8303.description: A scary, yet cozy lantern carved from a fruit. Don't smash it, it brings bad luck.

8304.name: Pearl Lantern
8304.description: A shimmering blue pearl in a scallop that illuminates your path above the dark depths of the sea.

8305.name: Soul Lantern
8305.description: A vessel with a hot, oil-like substance within.

8320.name: Wooden Shield
8320.description: A useful off-hand item to block hits from enemies.

8321.name: Toxic Defender
8321.description: A shield covered in toxic grime. Has a chance to poison enemies when blocking attacks.

8322.name: Octarine Shield
8322.description: An extremely durable shield infused with energy that increases health while holding it.

8323.name: Iron Shield
8323.description: A heraldic shield offering significant protection from attacks.

8330.name: Minion Detonator
8330.description: A pristine skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of greater death.

8331.name: Minion Kindler
8331.description: A rusted skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of lesser death.

8340.name: Swift Feather
8340.description: A mysterious feather that allows you to dash out of danger.

8341.name: Azeos' Dash Feather
8341.description: A colorful talon feather from Azeos, the Sky Titan. By holding it you can dash at a high speed.

8350.name: Blue Leather Tome
8350.description: An ancient book with stitched blue covers. Is that skin?

8351.name: Golden Jellyfish
8351.description: This rare jellyfish seems to do well without water and apparently it likes your company.

8352.name: Caveling ID
8352.description: A sturdy card that once belonged to a citizen of the forlorn metropolis. It's thousand of years old but the excellent print hasn't faded.

8353.name: Turtle Shell
8353.description: A hard shell that once belonged to a graceful sea creature. You feel much more protected when holding it.

8354.name: Omoroth's Beak
8354.description: The sharp mouth piece of Omoroth, the Sea Titan. It seems to be able to crush every material.

8355.name: Sentry Shield
8355.description: The discarded breast piece of a core sentry. It has just the right size to be used as a great shield and the ancient gemstone in its center sometimes shoots out energy as it blocks enemy attacks.

8356.name: Royal Gel
8356.description: A blob of slime with a tiny crown in its center. With the right headpiece you can reign over all slimes.

8357.name: Crystal Meteor Chunk
8357.description: A very big ancient gemstone fused from smaller shards. It emits a strange energy that makes you feel nauseous and feverish.

8358.name: Scorching Aegis
8358.description: The crust of molten rock, formed to be wielded like a shield.

8359.name: Concealed Blade
8359.description: A knife attached to a wrist band hidden among layers of fabric. It's perfect for an unsuspected stealth attack.

8360.name: Smithing Glove
8360.description: Reinforced with several rare materials, this glove can withstand great heat and is a must have for every experienced blacksmith.

8361.name: Oracle Deck
8361.description: The complete set of oracle cards. Bringing them together strangely restored the cards to perfect condition and now they emit a powerful, enlightening aura.

8362.name: Core Iris
8362.description: A manufactured crystal that looks like the eye of the core. This one is raw and unfinished, as if something interrupted the process.

8363.name: Pet Rock
8363.description: It's Bob the pet rock. Don't drop or throw him, he has feelings too.

8364.name: Hydra Bone Shield
8364.description: The heavy top part of a hydra's skull. Made to withstand deep pressure within the earth, it makes for a great protection in battle.

8365.name: Hydra Tooth
8365.description: The long fang of a hydra. It emanates a primal energy that is waiting to be harnessed.

8366.name: Trinity Heart
8366.description: A symbiosis of an ancient gemstone with organic matter, resulting in a physically impossible material. It pulsates in energetic rhythms of three, a celestial pattern that must have been of utter importance to a spacefaring species.

8368.name: Rift Lens
8368.description: A peculiar handheld device, used for short range teleportation.

8369.name: Moonstone
8369.description: This pristine crystal is filled with energy. It makes you feel determined.

8370.name: Scratched Stone
8370.description: The claw marks in this rock reveal dormant energies inside, waiting to be awoken.

8371.name: Magnet
8371.description: A magnet with an impressive draw that defies the limits of electromagnetics.

8372.name: Remote Boom Clicker
8372.description: For when you want to make things go boom, but from a comfy distance!

8373.name: Hookshot
8373.description: A barbed hook attached to a rope and belt that can fasten onto nearby terrain with ease.

8374.name: Gilded Hookshot
8374.description: A fancy barbed hook attached to a chain and belt that can fasten onto distant terrain with ease.

8380.name: Spicy Lure
8380.description: A well-seasoned type of lure that attracts fish and other things more quickly.

8381.name: Sweet Lure
8381.description: A sugary type of lure that increases the chance of catching fish instead of loot.

8382.name: Glowing Lure
8382.description: A luminous type of lure that increases the chance of pulling up loot.

8383.name: Sticky Lure
8383.description: An icky type of lure that may stick on to fish that didn't even bite.

8384.name: Expert Lure
8384.description: A masterwork lure made from edible and magical parts, meant to attract the one big catch that lingers in deep waters.

8385.name: Purple Lure
8385.description: A shimmering lure that catches the eye of more rare fish.

8386.name: Green Lure
8386.description: A pointy lure that can stick to fish from the outside to catch more and catch them faster.

8387.name: Red Lure
8387.description: A wiggly lure that looks like a red worm, large enough to allow more than one fish to get caught sometimes.

8400.name: Miner Backpack
8400.description: Every underground miner needs one of those!

8401.name: Ghorm's Stomach Backpack
8401.description: A well-preserved stomach portion of the Devourer, comes with two handy straps.

8402.name: Scarlet Shell Backpack
8402.description: A hard-case backpack with lots of space and additional protection.

8403.name: Explorer Backpack
8403.description: A simple backpack made for traveling the underground caves. Holds quite a few items.

8404.name: Octarine Backpack
8404.description: A strange backpack that has more space inside than it looks like from the outside.

8405.name: Morpha's Bubble Backpack
8405.description: An elastic backpack with lots of space that formed from one of Morpha's outer growths.

8406.name: Small Backpack
8406.description: A simple backpack, made from smoothened bark.

8407.name: Scholar Backpack
8407.description: Has the comforting smell of musty old books.

8450.name: Small Ore and Block Pouch
8450.description: A small pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8451.name: Medium Ore and Block Pouch
8451.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8452.name: Small Seed and Crop Pouch
8452.description: A small pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8453.name: Medium Seed and Crop Pouch
8453.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8454.name: Small Valuable Pouch
8454.description: A small pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8455.name: Medium Valuable Pouch
8455.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8456.name: Small Fish Pouch
8456.description: A small pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8457.name: Medium Fish Pouch
8457.description: A medium pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8458.name: Large Ore and Block Pouch
8458.description: A large pouch made exclusively for ores and blocks, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8459.name: Large Seed and Crop Pouch
8459.description: A large pouch made exclusively for seeds and crops, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8460.name: Large Valuable Pouch
8460.description: A large pouch made exclusively for valuables, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8461.name: Large Fish Pouch
8461.description: A large pouch made exclusively for fish, with dedicated slots that auto-sort items as you gather them.

8462.name: Potion Pouch

8501.name: Wood Helm

8503.name: Caveling Hood
8503.description: Light armor hood that hides the face.

8504.name: Iron Helm
8504.description: Tough helm fit for knights. Comes with a visor and a flamboyant plume.

8505.name: Bronze Helm
8505.description: This helm repels slight blows to the head.

8509.name: Carapace Helm
8509.description: A chitin-plated head piece, wearing it fills you with the urge to dig paths through the darkness.

8510.name: Larva Helm
8510.description: No need for fancy hats. Just grub.

8511.name: Scarlet Helm
8511.description: Menacing-looking horned helm, fits perfectly with the rest of the set.

8512.name: Hunter Hood
8512.description: This hood is made from big leaves tucked into a headband. Lets you blend into green environments.

8513.name: Farmer's Hat
8513.description: Tuck a straw in your mouth and get ready for a whole day of relaxing on the porch.

8514.name: Octarine Helm
8514.description: A strange headgear with no visor. For some reason you can still see clearly when putting it on.

8515.name: Radical Rabbit Ears
8515.description: A cute hood featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

8516.name: Scholar's Hood
8516.description: A strange hood made from white linen and gold, in its shade you feel more intelligent than usual.

8517.name: Diving Helm
8517.description: This heavy chunk of metal was used to explore deep waters, unfortunately it's leaking now. Still works as a nice armor piece.

8518.name: Slime Helm
8518.description: A gooey, constantly dripping helm that covers half of your face.

8519.name: Sentry Helm
8519.description: The detached head of a core sentry. Wearing it feels incredibly clunky and heavy but it makes up for it with great protection.

8520.name: Sunglasses
8520.description: Nothing is more important than sporting cool sunglasses, even when it's dark.

8521.name: Omoroth's Helm
8521.description: An iron-cast helm with a scary grimace and potruding tentacles.

8522.name: King Slime Crown
8522.description: A rare headpiece that crowns you as king of all slimes. You feel very royal wearing it.

8523.name: Galaxite Helm
8523.description: A futuristic helmet fit for a space explorer. Looking through its visor is like looking into the depths of the universe.

8524.name: Assassin Hood
8524.description: A mysterious hood for true desert dwellers that keeps the face in shade.

8525.name: Magma Horn Armor
8525.description: A pretty awesome piece of equipment that makes you look like the harbinger of doom.

8526.name: Scarab Visor
8526.description: A helm made in the design of Ra-Akar, casting its central eye on your enemies.

8527.name: Miner's Protective Helm
8527.description: A handy helm with integrated goggles and a still functioning headlamp.

8528.name: Paladin Mask
8528.description: A mysterious piece of equipment with a golden mask. It seems to have been granted to warriors of high rank.

8529.name: Pumpkin Head
8529.description: A fruit head with a carved-in face. For how disgusting it feels from the inside, it looks pretty cool on the outside.

8530.name: Spooky Blanket Hood
8530.description: A cheap last-minute attempt to get ready for the spooky season.

8531.name: Frankenbrute Head
8531.description: Put more head on your head. Doesn't necessarily add up to more brain, though.

8532.name: Godsent King Mask
8532.description: A unique, royal piece of armor resembling the head of the state, crowning it as a descendant of the gods. It was intended for a future that never came.

8533.name: Skirmisher Cap
8533.description: A headpiece worn by caveling skirmishers which has been cobbled together with larvaskin, leaves and dirty cloth.

8534.name: Festive Hat
8534.description: A warm, soft hat to keep ones ears warm in the cold season. You can't get around wearing one of those in winter.

8535.name: Gingerbreadman Head
8535.description: A funny headpiece made from gingerbread. Just ignore the creepy smile and soulless eyes.

8536.name: Gingerbread Hood
8536.description: This gingerbread headpiece has not been baked, so it remains flexible to be drawn over the head.

8537.name: Snowman Hat
8537.description: Whatever one is feeling at the moment, this hat covers it all up with a happy expression made from coal and carrots.

8538.name: Flower Crown
8538.description: A beautiful crown made from leaves and pink roses. It resembles a love that feels like eternal spring.

8539.name: Top Hat
8539.description: This hat is worn by everyone who considers themself an admirable adventurer equipped with a captivating charisma.

8540.name: Explorer's Hat
8540.description: A hat that's made to go adventuring. Never falls off, even when a giant boulder is chasing behind.

8541.name: Chef's Hat
8541.description: The hallmark of every professional cook. Proof that even in the undergrounds taste can have priority over nutrition.

8542.name: Radical Rabbit Headband
8542.description: A cute headband featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

8544.name: Wildwarden Mask
8544.description: A wooden mask with decorative leaves and horns attuned to the wildlife.

8545.name: Ranger Hood
8545.description: A dark hood of old cloth. Hardly anything but eyes set on your target peep through.

8546.name: Shrooman Cap
8546.description: It grows on your head. You can feel your wounds growing shut along with it.

8547.name: Pot Lid
8547.description: A heavy clay cover that has partially cracked and doubles down as a funny hat.

8548.name: Shaman Skull
8548.description: A skull covered in ritualistic markings. Its burning eye sockets ignite a fiery fury in you.

8549.name: Hivebone Helm
8549.description: A helm crowned with erratic fangs and thorns akin to those on the Hive Mother maw.

8550.name: Mercenary Headband
8550.description: The only thing you need to put on when you want to rush through the jungle as a one-man-army…wait, that was something else.

8551.name: Moldweb Helm
8551.description: A head-piece covered in living mold. Its pulse enhances your bodily functions.

8552.name: Plague Mask
8552.description: An eerie beaked mask. Its inside reeks of rancid death, yet lets you live to smell it.

8553.name: Solarite Barbute
8553.description: A nearly indestructible helm forged with patience and precision. When it is worn, you feel energized, lively and protected.

8554.name: Atlantean Worm Helmet
8554.description: A fierce looking helm that resembles the head of the Atlantean Worm. How it came to be is a mystery.

8555.name: Cooking Pot Lid
8555.description: A shiny metal cover that suppresses your boiling point.

8557.name: Cosmos Visor Helm
8557.description: A futuristic helm sealed under a big glass dome, leaving the view open to marvel at the miracles of space.

8558.name: Hazmat Helm
8558.description: Need to handle strange materials that emit even stranger radiation? Ask no more!

8559.name: Hydra Bone Helm
8559.description: The gruesome-looking empty skull of a hydra. One senses a malevolent presence when putting it on.

8560.name: Core Commander Helm
8560.description: The discarded headpiece of a high-rank armor. When worn, you can feel an immense power surging through your mind. It's whispering words you could never understand.

8561.name: Corrupt Warden Mask
8561.description: A wooden mask with decorative beads and a distant stare.

8562.name: Witch Doctor Hat
8562.description: A rustic top hat with various trinkets along the brim.

8563.name: Grim Hood
8563.description: This opposing hood is sure to strike fear into your opponents.

8565.name: Sorcerer Hood
8565.description: A hood worn by Initiated mages.

8566.name: Arcane Monk Blindfold
8566.description: The magic energies around you let you see just as clearly as with your eyes.

8567.name: Pandorium Helm
8567.description: Glistening and twisted. When worn, you feel attuned to all possible outcomes.

8568.name: Sulfossil Helmet
8568.description: Like a crown, when worn, you assert yourself dominant over the forces within this sulfuric mass.

8569.name: Chieftain Headdress
8569.description: This grand headdress shows clearly who's boss.

8570.name: Soaring Headgear
8570.description: A stylish hat and scarf, fit for one another.

8571.name: Tassel Earrings
8571.description: A pair of earrings, each with an elegant tassel decoration.

8572.name: Lily Pad Hat
8572.description: This lily pad appears unusually sturdy. It fits on your head nicely.

8573.name: Desert Guardian Mask
8573.description: A mysterious headpiece that resembles some sort of animal.

8574.name: Blast Helmet
8574.description: A heavy capsule that would be airtight if not for the narrow slits of its faceplate.

8575.name: Dreamer Headband
8575.description: A jade headband with hypnotically swaying fringes.

8577.name: Shadow Helmet
8577.description: A headgear that makes your mind feel void of emotion.

8578.name: Void-Fused Helmet
8578.description: A helmet brimming with dark pressure. You feel it could burst from the slightest crack.

8579.name: Inventor Goggles
8579.description: Goggles saturated with a maniacal green from one too many experimental mishaps.

8580.name: Welder Helmet
8580.description: A heat-resistant metal headpiece that protects the wearer from hazardous particles.

8581.name: Scarf
8581.description: A warm neckcloth for colder seasons.

8582.name: Bandana
8582.description: A rag fit for a suspenseful ruffian.

8602.name: Peasant Chest
8602.description: A simple makeshift armor for the upper body.

8603.name: Caveling Chest

8604.name: Iron Breastplate
8604.description: Charge into battle with this epic chest piece.

8611.description: Fierce upper body armor for true warriors.

8613.description: This organic breastplate armor is crested with thorns, allowing for stronger critical hits.

8614.description: This mysterious breastplate stimulates the muscles to swing your weapon much faster.

8633.name: Cupid Tunic

8636.name: Explorer's Jacket
8636.description: A leather jacket that's almost too warm to wear on adventures, but it looks cool!

8637.name: Chef's Jacket

8638.name: Wildwarden Pauldrons

8639.name: Ranger Tunic
8639.description: A light tunic with a quiver allowing for swift archery.

8640.description: Sticky things slide right off from this glossy elastic coat. The bright yellow is just a nice touch.

8643.name: Hivebone Breastplate

8644.name: Trenchcoat

8645.name: Stone Chestplate

8646.name: Moldweb Breastplate

8648.name: Cooking Pot Tub
8648.description: Only the ones really passionate about cooking dare to become the pot itself.

8649.name: Mercenary Tank Top

8653.description: Whatever the problem is, encountering it behind a protective suit makes it a little less stressful.

8654.name: Hydra Bone Breastplate
8654.description: The nearly indestructible rib bones of a hydra; they adjust to the chest size of the wearer.

8655.name: Core Commander Brigandine
8655.description: An astonishing upper body armor that sends pulses of energy through the body. It feels almost forbidden to wear it, brimming with more power than a human body could potentially handle.

8656.name: Corrupt Warden Tunic
8656.description: A simple tunic but with jewelry and fine fabrics layered on top.

8657.name: Witch Doctor Vest

8658.name: Grim Breastplate
8658.description: A grand, ominous robe with sharp shoulder pads.

8659.name: Apprentice Robe
8659.description: A plain robe worn by mages in training.

8660.name: Sorcerer Robe
8660.description: A robust robe, using magic fused into the fabric to withstand attacks.

8661.name: Arcane Monk Cloak
8661.description: A cloak with particular magical patterns woven in.

8662.name: Pandorium Chestplate and Bracers
8662.description: These plates feel inexplicably connected to your entire nervous system. When worn, your muscles twitch with anticipation.

8663.name: Sulfossil Cuirass

8664.name: Chieftain Tunic
8664.description: Made with some of the finest Bambuck wool.

8665.name: Soaring Poncho

8666.name: Tassel Top

8667.name: Lily Pad Tunic
8667.description: A light shirt with a lily pad strapped over. A little flower is keeping it tied in place.

8668.name: Desert Guardian Tunic
8668.description: A light tunic over a dark, full-body layer underneath. Fitted with golden jewelry.

8669.name: Blast Plackart
8669.description: A rusty amalgam of plates fit to endure the fiercest demolitions.

8670.name: Dreamer Vest
8670.description: A pair of near weightless jade sashes connected by a gilded ring, flowing in light breeze.

8672.name: Shadow Chestplate
8672.description: A chestpiece that makes your heart feel hollow.

8673.name: Void-Fused Chestpiece
8673.description: A heavy contraption of a chestpiece consisting of rusty layers welded to a glasslike dark material.

8674.name: Inventor Apron

8675.name: Welder Chestplate
8675.description: A heat-resistant metal chestpiece filled with of thermoreductive slag wool.

8701.name: Wood Pants

8703.description: These pants don't cover much but make your movement more elusive.

8706.name: Scarlet Pants
8706.description: March through your enemies and don't look back.

8708.name: Octarine Pants
8708.description: This peculiar leg protection phases energy through your whole body.

8709.name: Scuba Fins

8719.name: Scarab Legs

8723.description: Fairly stiff legs are the main feature of this baked armor, as well as crumbs between the toes.

8724.name: Suit Pants

8725.name: Explorer's Pants

8727.name: Wildwarden Pants

8732.name: Stone Pants

8734.name: Moldweb Pants

8815.description: A shiny trinket combining the most valuable of materials.

8816.name: Ancient Gem Necklace
8816.description: A necklace crafted with only using ancient gemstones as well as a super rare white version.

8817.name: Skull Necklace
8817.description: A morbid necklace made from tiny caveling skulls. They're too small to have been children.

8818.name: Eostre Necklace
8818.description: A curved twig holding a golden egg at its end. It is a sign of renewal and fertility.

8819.name: Neptune Necklace
8819.description: A true trinket of the sea, made from kelp and a trident pendant. Mistaking you for a mythic sea ruler, fish come to you more often.

8820.name: Omoroth's Necklace
8820.description: A piece of jewelry with a striking likeness to the sea titan. Wearing it you feel in tune with the Sunken Sea, enhancing your body in multiple ways.

8821.name: Octarine Necklace
8821.description: A necklace made from pure octarine filled with magic energy.

8822.name: Scarlet Chunk Necklace
8822.description: The scarlet variant of an iron chunk necklace. It raises your defense even more and gives additional benefits.

8823.name: Coral Amulet
8823.description: A necklace made with a pretty coral badge and white pebbles.

8824.name: Polished Octarine Necklace
8824.description: A necklace made from pure octarine filled with magic energy.

8825.name: Polished Scarlet Chunk Necklace
8825.description: The scarlet variant of an iron chunk necklace. It raises your defense even more and gives additional benefits.

8826.name: Polished Coral Amulet
8826.description: A necklace made with a pretty coral badge and white pebbles.

8827.name: Conch Shell Necklace
8827.description: A beautiful necklace featuring a small shell. When you hold it up to your ear you can hear distant waves.

8828.name: Oceanheart Necklace
8828.description: A big blue diamond is the centerpiece of this extraordinary treasure. You feel loved when holding it up to your chest.

8829.name: Rusted Necklace
8829.description: This pendant used to look pretty but now it's rusted to the core.

8830.name: Torc Necklace
8830.description: A piece of jewelry for the neck that's merely a hoop with a gap. Worn by many different cultures throughout world history.

8831.name: Ra-Akar's Necklace
8831.description: A necklace of the desert with a strong resemblance of the sand titan. Wearing it grants you additional protection and extra damage.

8832.name: Nomad Necklace
8832.description: Made from ragged cloth and metal badges this witness of the desert gives you a keen advantage on attacks.

8833.name: Bone Necklace
8833.description: A primitive piece of jewelry made from small bones. Early humans have also made these for many different reasons.

8834.name: Black Necklace
8834.description: A necklace made from pitch-black metal that leaves dark smudges on your neck.

8835.name: Flame Necklace
8835.description: A mysterious necklace with a burning pendant. It glows intensively but doesn't scorch the skin.

8836.name: Fusioned Chunk Necklace
8836.description: A misshappen necklace that combines chunks of all kinds of materials.

8837.name: Samhain Offering Necklace
8837.description: A blessed necklace offered as a gift to farewell the warm season. It represents the harvest and the evening sun.

8838.name: Valentine Necklace
8838.description: A golden necklace featuring a big, shiny heart. You feel something you can't describe, when wearing it so close to your own.

8839.name: Fang Necklace
8839.description: A status symbol among tribal cavelings. You can sense blood lust from the loose tooth.

8840.name: Wildwarden Necklace
8840.description: An animalistic emblem decorated with golden trinkets that ring out to the wild.

8841.name: Atlantean Worm Necklace
8841.description: This organic necklace looks like a miniature version of the Atlantean Worm. Maybe it is a juvenile that would grow to become as large as its origin.

8842.name: Tower Shell Necklace
8842.description: A necklace featuring a coiling shell. Its ever turning spiral structure is captivating.

8843.name: Glass Bead Necklace
8843.description: A captivating necklace that catches your enemies off-guard so that they lower their defense. Unfortunately it has the same effect on you.

8844.name: Pyrdra's Necklace
8844.description: A scorching necklace that imbues the holder with powers of the burning heat.

8845.name: Crescent Necklace
8845.description: Grants the bearer access to deeper wellsprings of power.

8846.name: Soul Medallion
8846.description: A depressing stone amulet. You hear whispering...

8847.name: Bomb Necklace
8847.description: A necklace made from a fuse tied to a tiny bomb. Hold on to your head if it sizzles right next to your ear.

8848.name: Black Charm Necklace
8848.description: A perfectly black trinket that absorbs any light cast upon it.

8850.name: Clot Ring
8850.description: A blood-red ring that latches onto your finger.

8851.name: Larva Ring
8851.description: A living ring, not for the squirmish to wear.

8852.name: Wooden Thorn Ring
8852.description: A circular, brambly root with sharp thorns pointing outward.

8853.name: Glow Tulip Ring
8853.description: A luminous ring that holds the essence of glow tulips.

8854.name: Swift Ring
8854.description: Wearing this winged ring creates a slight wind that pushes you forward.

8855.name: Ring of Rock
8855.description: Simple ring found in the deepest of rocks.

8856.name: Ring of Stone
8856.description: Simple ring carved out of stone.

8857.name: Gold Crystal Ring
8857.description: A precious ring featuring ancient gemstones.

8858.name: Melting Crystal Ring
8858.description: A gooey ring dripping slippery slime on the floor.

8859.name: Sky Ring
8859.description: This ring reminds you of the wide open sky.

8860.name: Caveling Mother's Ring
8860.description: An old crystal ring, holding it fills you with a sad feeling you can't describe.

8861.name: Petal Ring
8861.description: A precious ring that has naturally grown in the yellow blossoms of the jungle caves.

8862.name: Mold Ring
8862.description: A soft ring slowly releasing mold spores.

8863.name: Rusted Ring
8863.description: A ring from the depths that someone must have lost long time ago.

8864.name: Sea Foam Ring
8864.description: A translucent ring that looks like a wave frozen in time.

8865.name: Polished Gold Crystal Ring
8865.description: A precious ring featuring ancient gemstones.

8866.name: Polished Glow Tulip Ring
8866.description: A luminous ring that holds the essence of glow tulips.

8867.name: Polished Swift Ring
8867.description: Wearing this winged ring creates a slight wind that pushes you forward.

8868.name: Ancient Gem Ring
8868.description: This mysterious ring is entirely made out of ancient gemstones, featuring a super rare white one.

8869.name: Ivy's Ring
8869.description: An organic ring grown from slime covered thorns.

8870.name: Skull Ring
8870.description: A grotesque blood-red ring, crested with a tiny caveling skull.

8871.name: Ostara Ring
8871.description: A ring made of leaves and small golden eggs. It is a sign of emerging life and spring.

8872.name: Morpha's Ring
8872.description: A strange, little loop made from blue slime, it almost slides off of your finger.

8873.name: Coral Ring
8873.description: An intricate ring naturally grown from pink, branchy corals.

8874.name: Goldfish Ring
8874.description: A quite lively little ring that tries to swim off of your finger. By the time it realizes it's merely a ring it has already forgot about it again.

8875.name: Lucky Ring
8875.description: A cheaply made ring from a vending machine. If you believe hard enough you may feel more lucky.

8876.name: Ancient Guardian Ring
8876.description: A relic that is made in the same way as the Ancient Guardian Necklace, made for fending off the strongest of foes.

8877.name: Omoroth's Ring
8877.description: A plated looping tentacle that wraps around your finger. Stemming from a titan, it enhances your might in fighting these giant monsters.

8878.name: Octarine Ring
8878.description: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

8879.name: Magnetic Ring
8879.description: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

8880.name: Golden Spike Ring
8880.description: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

8881.name: Polished Octarine Ring
8881.description: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

8882.name: Polished Magnetic Ring
8882.description: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

8883.name: Polished Golden Spike Ring
8883.description: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

8884.name: Spine Ring
8884.description: A ring found at the skeleton of a giant ocean creature. It's made from tiny cervical vertebrae.

8885.name: Wooden Ring
8885.description: A simple wooden ring, nothing more, nothing less.

8886.name: Topaz Ring
8886.description: A precious little ring with a yellow gemstone on top.

8887.name: White Glass Ring
8887.description: This ring is made from a milky, translucent material. The light it reflects makes it harder for enemies to hit you.

8888.name: Septum Ring
8888.description: A golden piece of jewelry that's not put onto the finger but rather on the nose.

8889.name: Ring of Sand
8889.description: A strange ring made from sand that is held together by the currents of time.

8890.name: Bone Ring
8890.description: A prehistoric, crude ring made from bone. Rings like these have been discovered in early human graves.

8891.name: Nomad Ring
8891.description: This small finger band is made from ragged cloth to keep it from heating up in the scorching desert valleys.

8892.name: Black Ring
8892.description: A ring made from pitch-black metal, darkened by the constant presence of immense heat.

8893.name: Flame Ring
8893.description: This strange ring produces a flame that affects anything but its wearer.

8894.name: Bomb Ring
8894.description: A ring crowned with a little bomb idol. Handling explosives while wearing it results in an even stronger blast.

8895.name: Noble Ring
8895.description: An expensive looking ring featuring a ruby. It must have belonged to someone wealthy.

8896.name: Double Ring
8896.description: This ring is made to be put on two fingers at the same time. Revolutionary.

8897.name: Samhain Curse Ring
8897.description: A cursed ring that was used to welcome the cold season into the lands. It represents decay and darkness.

8898.name: Valentine Ring
8898.description: A golden ring featuring a candy-colored heart. The perfect gift to give to someone you like.

8899.name: Wildwarden Ring
8899.description: A wooden ring with two smaller rings around it. One symbolizes the warden and the other the bonded beast.

8900.name: Copper Sword
8900.description: A good weapon for slaying foes.

8901.name: Iron Sword
8901.description: A strong weapon for slaying foes.

8902.name: Scarlet Sword
8902.description: A great weapon for slaying foes.

8903.name: Tin Sword
8903.description: A sharp weapon for slaying foes.

8905.name: Slime Sword
8905.description: A strange weapon, good for damaging enemies and slowing them down.

8906.name: Octarine Sword
8906.description: An extraordinary weapon for slaying foes.

8907.name: Slippery Slime Sword
8907.description: A blue variant of the slime sword. It sometimes spreads slime onto your enemies that makes them slide around.

8908.name: Galaxite Sword
8908.description: An otherworldly weapon for slaying foes.

8909.name: Wooden Sword
8909.description: A crude weapon to fend off foes.

8910.name: Solarite Sword
8910.description: A superior weapon for obliterating foes.

8911.name: Atlantean Worm Sword
8911.description: A dislodged, razorsharp mandible of the Atlantean Worm. The maker of the deep sea.

8930.name: Larva Spike Club
8930.description: A bludgeoning weapon that is hard to withstand.

8931.name: Crystal Shard Club
8931.description: This bludgeoning weapon is made from fragile crystal, that can send out splinters when swung.

8940.name: Poisonous Sickle
8940.description: Farming tool that turned into a weapon when a great threat had to be slain.

8950.name: Broken Handle
8950.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Even though it's only the handle it already feels mysteriously balanced in your hand.

8951.name: Rune Song
8951.description: A legendary sword that hums when swung through the air. Its durability is a testament to extraordinary craftsmanship, said to carry the whispers of ancient battles within its blade.

8952.name: Tin Dagger
8952.description: A small blade that allows for quick stabs.

8953.name: Tin Axe
8953.description: A slower but more damaging weapon against multiple enemies.

8954.name: Battle Axe
8954.description: A menacing weapon that swings wide and hits hard.

8955.name: Scarlet Dagger
8955.description: This wavy, crimson dagger pierces through most materials.

8956.name: Ritual Dagger
8956.description: This unusual dagger is made from a big gemstone shard. There are dark red spots on the handle.

8957.name: Octarine Axe
8957.description: This crescent-shaped weapon hits hard and magically arcs towards enemies' weak spots.

8958.name: Anchor Axe
8958.description: This heavy weapon is actually just a ship anchor. Hits very hard and can throw enemies off.

8959.name: Lava Battle Axe
8959.description: A smoldering, heavy weapon that looks like it was just taken out of the forge.

8960.name: Galaxite Dagger
8960.description: A quick-stabbing weapon made for close combat. The blade is so fine that it can cut a hair into two pieces lengthways.

8961.name: Rusty Dagger
8961.description: A blade so corroded it only vaguely resembles copper. It's deceptively sharp.

8970.name: Tentacle Whip
8970.description: An elastic tentacle that lashes out at enemies from afar. It's still alive and wiggling in your hand.

8971.name: Hunting Spear
8971.description: A very crude long-reach weapon used by the cavelings dwelling in the Clay Caves. Good to hunt larvae and place them over a fire.

8972.name: Prehistoric Crystal Spear
8972.description: One of the first weapons ever made by mankind, but this one has an ancient gemstone in place of a normal spearhead.

8973.name: Iron Halberd
8973.description: A luxurious pole-weapon fit for a royal guardian and perfect for poking at adversaries.

8974.name: Hydra Bone Sword
8974.description: A jagged sword made from a hydra's spine. It is not particularly sharp but its uneven shape can tear dangerous wounds into your opponents.

8976.name: Pandorium Axe
8976.description: This weapon has been designed by minds twisted in the darkness of The Passage. It tears more than it cuts.

8977.name: Void Club
8977.description: This club feels light when held, yet heavy when swung.

9001.name: Bomb
9001.description: A stronger explosive for crowd control and facing giant enemies.

9002.name: Crude Bomb
9002.description: A small explosive to blast walls and enemies.

9003.name: Large Bomb
9003.description: A very strong explosive for massive destruction.

9004.name: Red Firework Rocket
9004.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a red explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9005.name: Green Firework Rocket
9005.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a green explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9006.name: Blue Firework Rocket
9006.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a blue explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9007.name: Yellow Firework Rocket
9007.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a yellow explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9008.name: Purple Firework Rocket
9008.description: A firework rocket that flies up and results in a purple explosion when ignited, perfect for all kinds of celebration. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9009.name: The BIG
9009.description: This giant firework rocket needs some time to take off but rewards patience with a spectacular explosion. Can be set off by using a torch or electricity on it.

9010.name: Sulfur Bomb
9010.description: A large bomb harnessing the power of pressurized toxic gas.

9011.name: Fire Grenade
9011.description: An explosive fit for those who want to set the world on fire!

9012.name: Poison Grenade
9012.description: An explosive that is hard to recover from.

9013.name: Grenade
9013.description: A throwable explosive that bounces on impact.

9014.name: Stun Grenade
9014.description: Creates a blast that overwhelms the senses.

9015.name: Charm Grenade
9015.description: Nothing is as persuasive as a little explosive charm.

9016.name: Mouse Bomb
9016.description: A forward moving explosive that explodes on impact.

9017.name: Blunder Bomb
9017.description: Triggers a directional sequence of explosions, perfect for clearing a path.

9018.name: Void Bomb
9018.description: Draws in nearby enemies before spitting them out in pieces.

9019.name: Proximity Bomb
9019.description: An explosive that is triggered when an enemy steps near.

9020.name: Oil Grenade
9020.description: Splatters combustible oil all over the ground.

9021.name: Blast Bundle
9021.description: Thrown much like a regular grenade... but creates a stronger blast!

9100.name: Flintlock Musket
9100.description: Can't argue much with a handful of lead coming right at you.

9102.name: Slingshot
9102.description: Simple ranged weapon to fire away at enemies.

9110.name: Grubzooka
9110.description: The heavy shots from the Grubzooka also tear down any dirt, sand and turf walls in its path.

9111.name: Scrapzooka
9111.description: A weapon of scrap. Because some problems are best blasted away.

9112.name: Blowpipe
9112.description: A simple weapon loaded with poisonous darts.

9113.name: Fireball Staff
9113.description: A magical staff that the caveling shamans use in their rituals and against uninvited guests.

9114.name: Octarine Bow
9114.description: A strange bow that enhances the way arrows fly, allowing for quicker shots.

9115.name: Phantom Spark
9115.description: A legendary, masterfully crafted bow that shoots pure energy projectiles. Sometimes those pierce the veil of time and space, calling upon the spirits of the past.

9116.name: Iron Bow
9116.description: A sturdy bow to shoot foes from afar.

9117.name: Wood Bow
9117.description: A crude bow to shoot foes from afar.

9118.name: Scholar's Staff
9118.description: A magical staff wielded by caveling scholars that utilizes an ancient gemstone to produce powerful bolts of energy.

9119.name: Bubble Gun
9119.description: A strange ranged weapon that shoots out hovering bubbles, adding slippery movement on contact.

9120.name: Throwing Daggers
9120.description: A set of curved blades. They're evenly balanced so that throwing them is as easy as pointing a finger.

9121.name: Galaxite Chakram
9121.description: This unique throwing weapon requires finesse and dexterity to be used to its full potential.

9122.name: Burnzooka
9122.description: This fiery weapon was modeled after the grubzooka but enhanced with lava rock shielding to contain its power. Can blast away stone walls and anything weaker.

9123.name: Shellzooka
9123.description: A powerful weapon launching explosive projectiles that resemble the center eye of a bomb scarab.

9124.name: Snowball
9124.description: A handy projectile to start some fights with the neighbours' children. Can also be collected and further processed.

9125.name: Cupid Bow
9125.description: A bow that hits right into the heart of its target and has a chance to infatuate it with the archer.

9126.name: Sticky Stick
9126.description: This staff is drenched in slime that never seems to end no matter how much is flung away.

9130.name: Wood Crossbow
9130.description: A small wooden crossbow that swiftly shoots bolts.

9131.name: Scarlet Crossbow
9131.description: A heavy metallic crossbow that shoots potent bolts.

9132.name: Solarite Crossbow
9132.description: A grand glimmering crossbow that shoots mighty bolts.

9133.name: Ricochet Shuriken
9133.description: A four-bladed throwing weapon that bounces back and forth across the room. Slicing any enemy in its path.

9134.name: Void Gun
9134.description: A particle weapon with unknown inner workings. It emits balls of void that distort spacetime to inflict high damage.

9135.name: Stormbringer
9135.description: Augmented by a mysterious energy, this weapon unleashes chaining arcs of lightning upon your foes. Holding it sends a tingling sensation through your arms.

9136.name: Chaos Staff
9136.description: An unpredictable, powerful weapon that weaves chaotic ancient energy into all kinds of projectiles. The enemy will never know what's coming for them.

9137.name: Scrap Minigun
9137.description: A gun-like apparatus that manages to convert disposable debris into a flurry of cutting missiles.

9138.name: Flamethrower
9138.description: A bulky tank attached to a hose spraying ignited fuel, ready to set the world ablaze.

9139.name: Credence of Ruin
9139.description: A relic born of cult devotion and void corruption. Forged from S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s own frame and sanctified components of Breaker's Reach.

9140.name: Volcano Mortar
9140.description: Erupts molten chunks into the air to crash like meteoroids.

9141.name: Stone Mortar
9141.description: A handheld cannon hurling rocks into the air. They won't know what hit 'em!

9151.name: Arcane Staff
9151.description: Unleash a torrent of arcane energies.

9152.name: Zealot's Scimitar
9152.description: A brilliant sword that channels mana into the blade to increase its power.

9154.name: Sun Caller
9154.description: Used by great mages to conjure small stars.

9155.name: Corrupted Meteor Staff
9155.description: A weathered staff infused with cosmic corruption. It crackles with unfathomable energies and whispers of forbidden power.

9156.name: Noxious Meteor Staff
9156.description: A tainted staff laced with corroding blight. It sizzles with embittered energies that rain down a dense drop of toxin.

9157.name: Titan Breath
9157.description: Wrought by restrained paradox, it inhales energy to exhale a controlled cut through the aether. Anything trapped within is overwhelmed by the distilled entropy.

9176.name: Tome of the Dark
9176.description: More of a pamphlet, beginners guide to shadowmancy.

9177.name: Tome of the Deep
9177.description: A tome that contains powerful incantions barely utterable by the human tongue.

9178.name: Tome of the Dead
9178.description: A vile treatise on the conjuring of restless spirits.

9179.name: Tome of Ashes
9179.description: Reeks of sulfur and is hot to the touch.

9180.name: Tome of Sprouts
9180.description: A mystical tome germinating with verdant potential.

9181.name: Tome of Decay
9181.description: Flipping through its pages causes your fingers to go numb.

9183.name: Tome of Breach
9183.description: More of an unfinished journal detailing the author's obsession with unearthing secrets.

9184.name: Withered Scepter
9184.description: A weak hum resonates through the brittle wood.

9185.name: Runestone Scepter
9185.description: Formed in halls lost to time, though the stone remembers.

9186.name: Blightbloom Scepter
9186.description: Crafted from cursed roots, fed by rot and forbidden magic.

9187.name: Veil Crux
9187.description: An ancient scepter wrought from relics of distant biomes. Something beneath the world seems to recognize its command.

9188.name: Abyssal Scepter
9188.description: Woven from deep currents bound in coral and salt, its magic rebounds like the tide.

9189.name: Hollowcore Scepter
9189.description: A crystallized hollow core that hums with old magic.

9190.name: Pandoric Scepter
9190.description: Unearthed from a buried chamber surrounded by forgotten relics.

9316.name: Hydra Boss Ice Shard Mortar Projectile

9318.name: Hydra Boss Spawn Nilipede Mortar Projectile
