9400.name: Healing Potion
9400.description: A healthy elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes good.

9401.name: Enrage Potion
9401.description: A strong elixir that buffs your muscles and your temper.

9402.name: Stoneskin Potion
9402.description: A salty elixir that hardens your skin and makes you more resilient.

9403.name: Poison Aid Potion
9403.description: A purple, mucky liquid that tastes horrible but cures any poison.

9404.name: Greater Healing Potion
9404.description: A much healthier elixir that heals instantly. Also tastes great.

9405.name: Keen Potion
9405.description: A cold elixir that focuses your senses and aim.

9406.name: Guardian's Potion
9406.description: A potion that fills you with great courage and the ability to withstand the strongest of foes.

9407.name: Cave Coffee
9407.description: A strong, bottled brew made from unknown ingredients. After ingesting it's hard for you to stand still.

9408.name: Heart Berry Soda
9408.description: This canned sparkly drink is a pure explosion of taste and sweetness in your mouth.

9409.name: Crystal Water
9409.description: Crystal clear water that has been filtered through ancient gemstones.

9410.name: Unusual Potion
9410.description: A two-component potion that is risky to drink.

9411.name: Splendid Amalgam
9411.description: A boiling-hot metallic fluid that merges with the bodies' cells after consumption, making them more resilient.

9412.name: Arcane Potion
9412.description: A volatile concoction that amplifies your magical energy.

9413.name: Pact of Power Potion
9413.description: An ominous looking liquid that elevates the power of your summoned forces.

9414.name: Giant Mitochondrion
9414.description: This supersized organelle is a real powerhouse.

9415.name: Burn Resistance Potion
9415.description: Dousing yourself with this elixir makes you flame retardant. Fire may still hurt, but it won't linger.

9416.name: Mana Potion
9416.description: A potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes sweet.

9417.name: Greater Mana Potion
9417.description: A very potent elixir that instantly refills your inner power. Also tastes syrupy.

9600.name: Caveling Bread
9600.description: Dry, hard bread. It feels like chewing chalk but fills the stomach.

9601.name: Jingle Jam Cookie
9601.description: A special gift for participating in the Jingle Jam charity event.

9602.name: Food Ration
9602.description: Canned meal made to last for years. You should look for better food options soon.

9603.name: Cave Crunch
9603.description: A chunky, sweet snack in a wrapper. Must be thousands of years old and probably still edible for a couple more.

9604.name: Glazed Heart Berry
9604.description: A sugar-covered heart berry that's still juicy and fresh underneath. Delicious!

9605.name: Tentacle Jerky
9605.description: A dried piece of tentacle. It's quite tough and keeps your teeth busy.

9606.name: Chewy Cone Candy
9606.description: A super sweet candy that ends up in the gap of your teeth. And it's there to stay.

9607.name: Spooky Pop Candy
9607.description: It looks almost too scary to remove its wrapper. What tasty horrors might await behind?

9608.name: Evil Eye Candy
9608.description: The most wicked creation of all, its taste an insult to the living. Black licorice.

9609.name: Fruit Bread
9609.description: A traditionally baked fruit bread with powdered sugar on top. One slice is never enough!

9610.name: Winter Dinner
9610.description: A full meal to warm your belly in the cold season. Prepared with a roasted larva, hot heartberry sauce, dumplings and some greens.

9611.name: Hot Punch
9611.description: Sitting down with this nice beverage will send a shiver of cozyness down ones spine. It's spicy, fruity and simply tasty.

9612.name: Hot Chocolate
9612.description: A mug full of creamy, hot chocolate milk with small marshmallows on top. Drinking it feels like being a kid again.

9613.name: Winter Cookies
9613.description: Nicely decorated this handful of cookies will put one in a seasonal mood. There's even a little core-shaped one in there.

9614.name: Golden Chocolate
9614.description: A limited edition chocolate for the cold season. There is no golden ticket inside, instead the whole thing is made out of it!

9615.name: Box of Chocolates
9615.description: These chocolates come in a nice gift box and are mouth and heart melting.

9616.name: Distilled Love
9616.description: This beverage made from rare pink slime tastes like cotton sugar and makes your heart flutter.

9617.name: Kelp Dumpling
9617.description: A soft, warm dumpling that smells pretty... funny. You don't really want to know where that one came from.

9618.name: Atlantean Worm Heart
9618.description: This is but one of the many hundred hearts of the Atlantean Worm that give it the strength to hurl its gigantic body through the water. Therefore it brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

9619.name: Crystal Kelp
9619.description: A crystallized lump of marine plants.

9620.name: Lunar Cheese
9620.description: An aromatic snack that seems out of this world. Is it proof that the moon is made out of cheese after all?

9621.name: Paradise Fruit Basket
9621.description: A pure explosion of flavors enters your mouth when biting into these fruits.

9622.name: Oblidra's Heart
9622.description: This still beating heart of the Void Lord pulses inward rather than outward. It brims with vitality that you can now call your own.

9700.name: Orange Cave Guppy
9700.description: Small, orange fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

9701.name: Blue Cave Guppy
9701.description: Small, blue fish home to the dirt cave lakes.

9702.name: Rock Jaw
9702.description: A small shark that can break almost every material with one bite.

9703.name: Gem Crab
9703.description: This rare crab has ancient gemstones growing all over it.

9704.name: Dagger Fin
9704.description: The scales of this fish are thin like razorblades.

9705.name: Pink Palace Fish
9705.description: A pink, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

9706.name: Teal Palace Fish
9706.description: A greenish-blue, odd-looking fish with weirdly shaped fins.

9707.name: Crown Squid
9707.description: All hail the pale king of water!

9708.name: Yellow Blister Head
9708.description: A fish with large yellow bubbles on its head.

9709.name: Green Blister Head
9709.description: A fish with large green bubbles on its head.

9710.name: Devil Worm
9710.description: A hellspawn that dwells in the sea ground. Don't step on it.

9711.name: Vampire Eel
9711.description: A bloodsucking fish latching onto everything that has a pulse.

9712.name: Mold Shark
9712.description: A small predator of the murky mold waters.

9713.name: Rot Fish
9713.description: Half of its body is missing but somehow it's still alive. Creepy.

9714.name: Black Steel Urchin
9714.description: A rare sea critter with spikes as hard as steel.

9715.name: Azure Feather Fish
9715.description: A beautiful blue fish with scales that look like feathers.

9716.name: Emerald Feather Fish
9716.description: A beautiful green fish with scales that look like feathers.

9717.name: Spirit Veil
9717.description: A ghastly fish that floats in the air like it's still underwater.

9718.name: Astral Jelly
9718.description: Extremely rare type of jellyfish. It almost feels out of this world.

9719.name: Bottom Tracer
9719.description: A bright yellow fish with long barbels that it drags along the sea floor in search for food.

9720.name: Silver Dart
9720.description: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of blinking silver to confuse predators.

9721.name: Golden Dart
9721.description: This elusive fish appears in swarms as a spectacle of flickering gold to confuse predators.

9722.name: Pink Coralotl
9722.description: A small pink amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

9723.name: White Coralotl
9723.description: A small white amphibian with outward-protruding gills that look like corals. It also uses them to draw nutrients out of the waters of the Sunken Sea.

9724.name: Solid Spikeback
9724.description: A very defensive fish with rock-hard skin and sharp spikes protruding out.

9725.name: Sandy Spikeback
9725.description: A very defensive fish with sandstone skin and jagged spikes protruding out.

9726.name: Gray Dune Tail
9726.description: This gray, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

9727.name: Brown Dune Tail
9727.description: This brown, agile fish is able to move between water holes in the desert to change feeding grounds.

9728.name: Tornis Kingfish
9728.description: An extremely rare enigma of sea life that seems to unify all other fish beneath it.

9729.name: Dark Lava Eater
9729.description: A dark fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

9730.name: Bright Lava Eater
9730.description: A bright fish with fiery belly that seems to purely feed from liquid stone and the gemstones caught within.

9731.name: Verdant Dragonfish
9731.description: This draconic fish has green scales that can withstand remarkably high temperatures.

9732.name: Elder Dragonfish
9732.description: A draconic fish that is several hundred years old. The verdant color of its scales has long faded.

9733.name: Starlight Nautilus
9733.description: A mysterious living fossil that seems to have fused with precious metals and gemstones to ascend to a higher state of being.

9734.name: Beryll Angle Fish
9734.description: This moon-blue fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

9735.name: Glistening Deepstalker
9735.description: A crystal-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

9736.name: Cosmic Form
9736.description: A strange entity that is unlike any terrestrial sea life you have ever seen. Did it come from a place far away from earth?

9737.name: Jasper Angle Fish
9737.description: This sun-golden fish seemed to have had a normal body once, but the water of the Shimmering Frontier corrupted it to be crystalline through and through.

9738.name: Splendid Deepstalker
9738.description: A Solarite-plated predator that slithers through the glowing waters of the Shimmering Frontier, always on the hunt for something weaker.

9739.name: Terra Trilobite
9739.description: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its brown shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

9740.name: Litho Trilobite
9740.description: The mutated offspring of its extinct ancestor. Its gray shell had adapted to withstand extreme pressure.

9741.name: Pinkhorn Pico
9741.description: This little pink creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

9742.name: Greenhorn Pico
9742.description: This little green creature is entirely translucent with no visible brain. It seems unbothered being held.

9743.name: Riftian Lampfish
9743.description: An extraordinary creature that doesn't seem to be from this world. Its biology works entirely different from anything you know.

9800.name: Blackbug
9800.description: This tiny bug appears in many different places. Right now it's looking for a new home.

9801.name: Larvlet
9801.description: A tiny larva that doesn't harm you but likes to be collected and held in a warm hand.

9802.name: Moon Pincher
9802.description: This blue-purple crustacean always has its claws raised which gives it a seemingly happy expression.

9803.name: Dusk Fairy
9803.description: A tiny butterfly with very delicate wings. Catching it without harming them requires a lot of caution.

9804.name: Dream Messenger
9804.description: Said to be a bringer of good dreams this butterfly is always seen among sleeping creatures.

9805.name: Citrus Pinion
9805.description: An erraticly fluttering butterfly that has bright colors irritating to the naked eye.

9806.name: Ice Wind
9806.description: This blue butterfly flaps its wings so fast that it creates cold air streams.

9807.name: Crimson Wing
9807.description: A small butterfly with deep red wings that seeks the company of other critters.

9808.name: Little Death
9808.description: This small scorpion is harmless to humans but can easily kill smaller creatures if it needs food.

9809.name: Leafhopper
9809.description: A very nervous little fellow. The faintest hint of danger makes it jump away into safety.

9810.name: Earthworm
9810.description: A worm. Nothing special about it.

9811.name: Manyleg
9811.description: This desert critter has an unknown amount of legs. It would simply take too long to count them.

9812.name: Pest Bug
9812.description: A disgusting insect that moves with uncanny speed. It commonly is found in places that have darkness, dirt and food to offer.

9813.name: Sun Pincher
9813.description: This red-yellow crustacean always has its claws raised which gives it a seemingly happy expression.

9814.name: Gem Snail
9814.description: A small snail that slowly works its way through the dangers of the Shimmering Frontier.

9815.name: Snoot Fly
9815.description: Frantically flying around, this little mosquito pokes at other lifeforms for a potential drop of blood.

9816.name: Shadow Newt
9816.description: A dark fellow with seemingly unseeing eyes. But they stare deep into your soul.

9817.name: Drape Ray
9817.description: This luminous dweller drifts through the air like a calm breath, even in the most impetuous areas.

9818.name: Sniffling
9818.description: This skittish little rodent scurries around for hardened crumbs left in debris.

9819.name: Void Larvlet
9819.description: A tiny void larva that doesn't harm you but likes to be collected and held in a warm hand.

9900.name: Chipped Blade
9900.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Its glass-like appearance makes it look fragile but it's harder than any material you've seen.

9901.name: Clear Gemstone
9901.description: A piece of an ancient weapon. Even though it is of the same material as ancient gemstones, this one feels unnaturally clear and infused with a strange energy.

9902.name: Crystal Skull Shard
9902.description: An ancient crystal shard that is only a fraction of something bigger.

9903.name: Shutdown Protocol
9903.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of a sudden spike in energy levels before collapsing.

9904.name: Anomaly Report
9904.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of a disturbance in previous patterns resulting in more advanced processes.

9905.name: Overwrite Transcript
9905.description: This blue slate depicts a graph of an entity redistributing processing power from multiple sources.

9906.name: Channeling Gemstone
9906.description: A specially carved ancient gemstone that focuses energy at its tip. It seems to be the center piece of an ancient powerful weapon.

9907.name: Fractured Limbs
9907.description: Golden pieces that once seemed to be fused together to endure great pressure. Something inherently powerful must have broken them apart.

9908.name: Energy String
9908.description: A fine filament that has microscopic pieces of ancient gemstones woven into it. Its existence is proof of the absolute mastery over materials by whoever created it.

9909.name: Crystal Meteor Shard
9909.description: This piece is merely a fraction of an enormous ancient gemstone.

9910.name: Giant Bug Brain
9910.description: The main sensory organ of Ra-Akar. It has evolved to detect disturbances deep in the ground and might become useful later.

9911.name: Pink Hydra Eye
9911.description: One of the three eyes of Druidra. It has a deep connection to other hydra entities and plays a key role in attracting them.

9912.name: White Hydra Eye
9912.description: One of the three eyes of Crydra. It has a deep connection to other hydra entities and plays a key role in attracting them.

9913.name: Oblivion Fragment
9913.description: A piece of obliterated antimatter. It has a deep connection to entities living in negative space and plays a key role in attracting one.

9916.name: Void-Forged Barrel
9916.description: A fractured artillery tube, scavenged from the cult's excavation machines. Its surface is warped by void corrosion. Clearly meant to complete a larger design.

9917.name: Sanctified Firing Core
9917.description: An ignition device made from gemstone, once used by Sahabar's exiles to fuse prayer and machinery. Even dormant, it radiates the strange conviction of those who believed metal could carry faith. It seems built to align with something greater.

9918.name: S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s Mortar Housing
9918.description: The shattered launcher torn from S.A.H.A.B.A.R.'s frame. A faint inscription on the housing reads "Sanctified Artificial Herald Against Breach And Ruin". Its rails still hold lingering heat.

9919.name: Coiled Branch
9919.description: Its twigs curl around anything it touches with a firm grip. It could surely bind together the most volatile of pieces.

9920.name: Magma Rod
9920.description: Perpetually hot to the touch, cast in a highly arcana-inductive alloy. It would amplify great power if cooled enough to be properly wielded.

9921.name: Frozen Orb
9921.description: Cold to the touch, yet never melting. The light within seems ready to wreak havoc if warmed just enough to escape its frigid prison.

10000.name: Brown Easter Egg
10000.description: A dirty collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

10001.name: Rose Easter Egg
10001.description: An icky collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

10002.name: Gray Easter Egg
10002.description: A rocky collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

10003.name: Green Easter Egg
10003.description: A weedy collectible egg that can be used as currency for a certain merchant. Get as many as you can, they might not be around for long.

10004.name: Large Golden Egg
10004.description: Too precious to eat, too suspicious to leave alone. It might be used for something more than just decoration...

10005.name: Chicken Hat
10005.description: A derpy-looking chicken hat that will be center of attention at the next party. Clucking funny!

10006.name: Chicken Breast Piece
10006.description: Itchy feathers and a concerning lack of ventilation make this chicken body piece a bold choice of clothing.

10007.name: Chicken Pants
10007.description: These flashy pants are chicken skin-inducing and complete the look of an egg-citing easter costume.

10008.name: Eggcellent Hat
10008.description: Everyone wearing this oversized egg shell hat has only one mission: to become egg.

10009.name: Eggcellent Breast Piece
10009.description: A spacious, oval shape that is made from hopes, dreams and lime. In other words: Egg.

10010.name: Eggcellent Pants
10010.description: These cheaply made pants are as yellow as egg yolk and itchy beyond comprehension.

10011.name: Easter Pillar
10011.description: A beautiful decorative pillar, holding up high a planter containing spring flowers. A perfect way to greet the new season.

10012.name: Easter Egg Flowerpot
10012.description: Greenery and daisies pop out of this egg-shaped flowerpot. They resemble the awakening of spring.

10013.name: Daisy Flooring
10013.description: A handful of daisies, made to sprinkle some spring onto the floor. One package is enough to cover a 1x1 ground tile.

10014.name: Easter Garland
10014.description: This charming green garland is adorned with little daisies, making it a perfect addition to your Easter-themed walls.

10015.name: Easter Meadow Table
10015.description: Lay out your belongings on this soft, overgrown table that fits every nature-themed base.

10016.name: Easter Egg Lamp
10016.description: Illuminate your base with this decorative lamp, featuring a golden easter egg sitting in a nest of greenery.

10017.name: Easter Meadow Stool
10017.description: Sitting on this stool feels as if sitting on a freshly cut meadow. There is no better spot to place ones bottoms.

10018.name: Easter Pedestal
10018.description: A small 1x1 table made from creme-colored stone and a little leaf as cover. Simple, practical and still in line with the Easter spirit.

10019.name: Easter Workbench
10019.description: This small working table contains the right materials to create a selection of spring and Easter-themed decorations.

10100.name: Samhain Goodie Bag
10100.description: A bag full of spooky sweets and secrets. Pop it up to peek inside.

10101.name: Pumpkin Coin
10101.description: A mischievous-looking coin that can be traded for various, eerie goods.

10103.name: Eerie Floor
10103.description: Dark floor boards trodden for many years by unholy feet.

10104.name: Eerie Table
10104.description: An old table that was used to serve horrible dishes. The presence of those who devoured them still lingers.

10105.name: Eerie Stool
10105.description: A seating opportunity made from cursed wood, ready to scare your buttocks off.

10106.name: Eerie Dresser
10106.description: Years of misuse turned this dresser into what it is now. Hopefully it treats your clothes better.

10107.name: Eerie Chest
10107.description: A creaking chest, useful for storing belongings. There are faint growling noises that can be heard from inside.

10108.name: Twisted Roots Torch
10108.description: A torch that stands like an eerie beacon in the darkness of the caves.

10109.name: Eerie Rug
10109.description: An old rug with a mysterious sigil. A witness of too many séances.

10110.name: Candle Stack
10110.description: A set of candles for your decoration needs or the right atmosphere when summoning evil entities.

10200.name: Winter Present
10200.description: A mysterious gift with unknown contents. Rip it open and peek inside!

10201.name: Winter Wreath Wall Decoration
10201.description: This simple wreath will do nicely on any wall and show visitors that it's finally holiday.

10202.name: Holiday Sock Wall Decoration
10202.description: A cozy sock to put on the wall. By tradition these were filled with small trinkets and candy.

10203.name: Candy Cane Wall Decoration
10203.description: Two crossed candy canes that are rather for decoration, not consumption. Put them on the wall for a nice winter flair.

10204.name: Winter Candle Wall Decoration
10204.description: Two wintry candles sitting on a candle dish, made to be put on the wall. Careful with the fire, though.

10205.name: Snowflake Wall Decoration
10205.description: A delicate snowflake that will look great on the walls of your home.

10206.name: Luxury Winter Present
10206.description: A mysterious golden gift with unknown contents. Rip it open and peek inside!

10207.name: Decorated Winter Tree
10207.description: Celebrating the cold season is not complete without setting up one of these. The centerpoint of every well-decorated lawn or living room.

10208.name: Festive Table
10208.description: This big table serves as a nice basis to set up a great dinner and bring the family together.

10209.name: Festive Stool
10209.description: A nice little stool that goes well with a richly decorated table. It's hard to sit still on it when opening presents is due.

10210.name: Festive Fireplace
10210.description: This fireplace is a great addition to every base when it's cold outside. Crackling fire and the smell of burning wood add to a homely atmosphere.

10211.name: Snowman
10211.description: A cold fellow that came into existence by stacking large snowballs together. Keep it around to not feel as lonely anymore.

10212.name: Snowball Pyramid
10212.description: A traditional festive contruct built with snowballs and a light source in the middle.

10213.name: Candle
10213.description: This simple decorative candle can be placed anywhere to set up a cozy atmosphere.

10214.name: Festive Wall Lights
10214.description: A mix of colorful lights to decorate the walls with.

10215.name: Paintable Festive Wall Lights
10215.description: Small colorful lights to decorate the walls with.

10300.name: Valentine's Gift
10300.description: This rose and silver-colored gift is packed with a variety of different charming items.

10301.name: Love Letter
10301.description: A scented letter that contains words of love and appreciation. Give it to someone in dire need of affection.

10302.name: Heart-shaped Rug
10302.description: Nothing speaks "love" like a big fuzzy heart on the floor. It smells like wool and lavender.

10303.name: Valentine's Candles
10303.description: A handful of small, pink candles that fill the air with a whiff of vanille.

10304.name: Wall Hearts
10304.description: An assortment of hearts cut from paper. They look great on walls and make a base just a little bit more lovely.

10305.name: Heart Painting
10305.description: A simple painting showing nothing more than a heart. Sometimes this is all one needs in these dark times.

10306.name: Caveling Brute Plushie
10306.description: A big plushie, resembling a caveling brute holding a heart. Even those need a little bit of love sometimes.

10400.name: Green Party Hat
10400.description: This groovy green party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

10401.name: Red Party Hat
10401.description: This radical red party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

10402.name: Blue Party Hat
10402.description: This blazing blue party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

10404.name: Purple Party Hat
10404.description: This perky purple party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

10405.name: Anniversary Cake
10405.description: Drenched in blue glaze and stuck with candles, this glow tulip chocolate cake marks a special anniversary.

10500.name: White Cherry Blossom
10500.description: A silky white blossom that fell from a beautiful tree. In full bloom it has a faint almond fragrance and reminds one of the joys of life.

10501.name: Pink Cherry Blossom
10501.description: A vibrant pink blossom that fell from a "weeping" tree. Its short-lived blooming period reminds one of the transcience of life.

10502.name: White Cherry Tree
10502.description: This beautiful white tree is a traditional symbol of the joys of life. It is said that in spring a fairy maiden descends to awake the sleeping cherry trees with her breath.

10503.name: Pink Cherry Tree
10503.description: This "weeping" tree holds its branches low, letting the blossoms droop towards the ground. It is said that brave warriors took depictions of those trees with them into their final battle.

10600.name: Paper Lantern
10600.description: A cozy light that can create a warm atmosphere in any room. It even comes in different colors.

10601.name: Red Envelope
10601.description: A gift to symbolize good wishes and luck for the year ahead. Someone left it for you to open.

10602.name: Guardian Beast Statue
10602.description: An imposing monument to be placed in front of entrances, meant to keep figures with ill intent away.

10603.name: Mystic Knot Tassel
10603.description: Woven from woolen string, this decoration symbolizes good luck, prosperity and abundance.

10604.name: Wall Paper Lantern
10604.description: A set of small lanterns that go nicely on the walls. Just like their bigger counterparts, they exist in many different colors.

10605.name: Dragon Mask
10605.description: An intimidating but well-meaning mask that invokes the spirit of mythological dragons.

10606.name: Lucky Coin
10606.description: While this golden coin holds many favorable meanings, the most important one is that it can be spent at a certain merchant.

10607.name: Folding Screen
10607.description: A stylish set of panels. Great for dividing spaces or hiding your secret stash.

10608.name: Lucky Cat
10608.description: When powered by electricity, this ceramic charmer waves its paw as if to say, "Fortune favors the feline!"

15500.name: Meadow Tree
15500.description: The tranquility of the meadow produced a Lush Tree variant that grows golden-colored leafs. Plant it back into the ground to decorate your home.

15501.name: Meadow Bush
15501.description: A golden-colored patch of meadow grass to use as a decorative.

15502.name: Tall Meadow Grass
15502.description: A large golden-colored patch of tall meadow grass to use as a decorative.

16009.name: Potted Tree with Red Envelopes
16009.description: A small tree in a pot with decorative red envelopes hanging from the branches.

18802.name: Corrosion Staff
18802.description: An acrid, larval wand spewing searing corrosion.

18806.name: Blizzard Staff
18806.description: A frigid icicle thawing out its gale of frost wherever you command.

18809.name: Sniper Rifle
18809.description: A fine rifle designed for deliberate shots. Patience is key.

18850.name: Atlantean Worm Ring
18850.description: An organic ring that looks like one of the segments of the Atlantean Worm. It must have grown inside its body as an anomaly.

18851.name: Glass Bead Ring
18851.description: A captivating ring that catches your enemies off-guard so that they lower their defense. Unfortunately it has the same effect on you.

18852.name: Druidra's Ring
18852.description: A leafy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the poisonous nature.

18853.name: Crydra's Ring
18853.description: An icy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the cold elements.

18854.name: Crescent Ring
18854.description: Allows the bearer to reach further sources of wisdom.

18855.name: Toothed Ring
18855.description: This ring is sure to let your knuckles pack a stinging punch.

18856.name: Azure Ring
18856.description: A ring accented with oblong sections of bright blue.

18857.name: Singed Ring
18857.description: This soot-covered ring has endured more explosions than anyone cares to count.

18858.name: Moonbell Ring
18858.description: A carefully woven ring of leaves and Moonbell petals.

18859.name: Infested Ring
18859.description: A wretched ring covered in bulbous growths. It faintly pulses around your finger, as if about to burst.

18861.name: Scaled Ring
18861.description: A coarse ring made from crustacean scales. A prized addition to any beast hunter’s collection.

18862.name: Bubble Ring
18862.description: A fizzing ring of perpetually popping bubbles. What would happen if you blew air through it?

18863.name: Brimstone Shard Ring
18863.description: A thin metal ring with an affixed piece of sulfur. It reeks of scorched earth.

18864.name: Sacred Ring
18864.description: A violet ring with mysterious engravings along its wide rim.

18865.name: Lava Spike Ring
18865.description: A warm ring covered in spines of solidifed lava. It seems forged in the very magma that coats it.

18866.name: Power Ring
18866.description: A small gold ring with a deep blue gem. Carved on its sides are words of power.

18867.name: Clarity Ring
18867.description: A ring of so fine a cut crystal, it reflects a clear view of your environs.

18868.name: Brimstone Ring
18868.description: A hardened ring of smoked sulfur. It reeks of scorched earth.

18869.name: Warped Ring
18869.description: A weightless helix swirling with an arcane tinge. The part of your finger passing through the coil turns dark blue.

18870.name: Jailor's Ring
18870.description: A ring set with a dusky purple gem and decor reminiscent of miniature prison bars. Was it once used to bind spirits to its will?

18890.name: Hourglass Ring
18890.description: Has a small hourglass on top. The sand within has stopped flowing down.

18891.name: Vicious Ring
18891.description: The unsettling gaze of this ring causes minions to stay on high alert.

18892.name: Boundary Ring
18892.description: A simple ring that forms a magical veil.

18893.name: Puppet Ring
18893.description: An odd, ornate ring. You feel a closer bond with your minions whilst wearing it.

18894.name: Aether Ring
18894.description: A ring with tiny sconces that come ablaze with purple flames when you wear it.

18895.name: Helical Ring
18895.description: A nut fastener just the right size for your finger.

18900.name: Azure Necklace
18900.description: A thin chain necklace which holds a torus made of pure lapis lazuli.

18901.name: Orb Necklace
18901.description: A set of adjacent marbles on a straw fashioned into a necklace. Perhaps each orb has once represented a member of a team?

18902.name: Singed Necklace
18902.description: It is hard to tell how many explosive episodes this soot covered necklace has endured.

18903.name: Moonbell Necklace
18903.description: A carefully woven necklace of leaves and Moonbell petals.

18904.name: Thorn Necklace
18904.description: A prickly vine that you must slide carefully over your neck to not get stung.

18905.name: Codex Necklace
18905.description: An ominous pocket-book tied to the end of a purple lace.

18906.name: Smoke Pearl Necklace
18906.description: A necklace composed of oily pearls. They smell of burnt brine.

18907.name: Knight's Necklace
18907.description: A fancy velvet necklace with a delicate dagger as a pendant. For emergencies.

18908.name: Chime Necklace
18908.description: A jade necklace that holds dangling wind chimes. You feel more focused, thanks to its tonal rattling in the wind.

18909.name: Enigmatic Necklace
18909.description: A deep blue string that holds a pendant resembling an upside-down pyramid adorned with blue accents.

18910.name: Eruptive Necklace
18910.description: A gilded, robust carcanet. It feels like its warm rock pendant may erupt at any time.

18911.name: Helio Necklace
18911.description: A chain with a pendant of amber crystal. It refracts beams of light shone upon it like a sun.

18912.name: Needle Necklace
18912.description: A crystalized needle that's not quite stalactite, nor quite icicle. Useful for pinpoint precision.

18913.name: Warped Necklace
18913.description: A minute event horizon shackled to the likeness of a necklace.

18914.name: Bombshell Necklace
18914.description: A metallic cleft orb in chains. It is disturbingly warm to the touch.

18940.name: Warrior Helmet
18940.description: A soldier's sturdy headgear, allowing you to challenge foes headfirst.

18941.name: Warrior Chestplate
18941.description: A fighter's lifesaving chest armor, with leather straps worn from battle.

18942.name: Warrior Greaves
18942.description: A strider's trusty leg armor, providing safe footing with each march.

18943.name: Skirmisher Harness
18943.description: A back-worn harness made from dried larva skin, favored by caveling skirmishers.

18944.name: Bomb Scarab Visor
18944.description: A helm replica of a Bomb Scarab's head with a blazing glint in its singular eye.

18945.name: Bomb Scarab Harness
18945.description: An upper body armor composed of the shell of a Bomb Scarab.

18946.name: Bomb Scarab Legs
18946.description: A lower body armor mimicking the exoskeleton of a Bomb Scarab.

18947.name: Moss Mask
18947.description: A mask made of old pale bark with a light crown fashioned from spruce needles.

18948.name: Moss Chestpiece
18948.description: A chestpiece fashioned from greyed bark insulated by a thick cape of liverworts.

18949.name: Moss Leggings
18949.description: A pair of hollowed out old branches covered by a kilt of lichen.

18999.name: Make-A-Wish Hat
18999.description: A glimmering party hat for a generous heart. The caves feel a little less dark, and the world a little less gloomy thanks to your charity.

19000.name: Pug Plushie
19000.description: Its paws hold a small gamepad, and its large pupils glimmer with gratitude. A tag underneath reads, "Thank you, Präntare".

19001.name: Splintered Wooden Sword
19001.description: This simple sword has seen far more battles than its maker would ever suggest. A worn reminder that even the humblest blade can do the impossible, where every crack Dares the next blow to land.

19002.name: The Mad Hat
19002.description: A once-ordinary hat now stuffed with scribbled notes, maps, and theories about the underground. Listen closely, and it might just share a helpful hint or two.

19003.name: Pictographic Sketchbook
19003.description: A charming and colorful notebook filled with owl-like doodles of cavelings mining, dancing, and one brute bonking its own head with a stick.

19004.name: Keeper's Throne
19004.description: A core governing seat with traces of dog hairs. Fit for a keeper of both cores and pugs.
